verses.text: Yosuwa amaze gupfa, Abisirayeli babaza Uhoraho bati: “Ni uwuhe muryango uzotangura kuduga gutera Abanyakanani?”
Uhoraho arabishura ati: “Umuryango wa Yuda uzobe ari wo ugenda ubwa mbere, kuko ndabahaye intsinzi kuri iyo ntara.”

Abo mu muryango wa Yuda babarira abo mu muryango wa Simeyoni bati: “Nimuze tudugane mu ntara twahawe, tugwanye Abanyakanani. Natwe tuzoheza tubafashe gufata intara yanyu.” Nuko abo mu muryango wa Simeyoni bajana na bo.
Abo mu muryango wa Yuda bateye, Uhoraho abaha intsinzi ku Banyakanani n’Abaperizi, bicamwo abasoda ibihumbi cumi muri bo mu gisagara ca Bezeki.
Aho ni ho basanze umwami Adoni-Bezeki, bamugwanirizaho, bahaneshereza Abanyakanani n’Abaperizi.
Adoni-Bezeki arahunga, ariko baramukurikira baramufata, bamuca intoke z’inkumu n’amano makuru.

Maze Adoni-Bezeki aravuga ati: “Igihe kimwe nafashe abami mirongo indwi, bacibwa inkumu n’amano makuru, bakarya ibikorotse ku meza yanje. None Imana inyishuye ivyo nabakoreye.” Baca bamutwara i Yerusalemu apfirayo.
Abo mu muryango wa Yuda bongera batera Yerusalemu, barahafata. Bicisha inkota abahaba, baca barahaturira.
Hanyuma y’aho abo mu muryango wa Yuda baca bamanuka gutera Abanyakanani baba mu karere k’imisozi, i Negebu, no mu biyaya vyo mu ntango z’imisozi yo mu burengero.
Barabandanya batera Abanyakanani baba i Heburoni, ahahoze hitwa Kiriyati-Araba, banesha ab’i Sheshayi, Ahimani n’i Talumayi.
Bavuye aho baca barabandanya baja gutera abantu baba i Debiri, ahahora hitwa Kiriyati-Seferi.
Maze Kalebu aravuga ati: “Uwuzotera i Kiriyati-Seferi akahafata, nzomuha umukobwa wanje Akisa abe umugore wiwe.”
Otiniyeli mwene Kenazi, murumuna wa Kalebu arahafata; Kalebu aca amushingira umukobwa wiwe Akisa.
Akisa amaze kuba umugore wa Otiniyeli, aca amubwira ngo asabe se itongo. Akisa yururutse indogoba yiwe, Kalebu aramubaza ati: “Wipfuza iki?”
Akisa amwishura ati: “Ngirira ubuntu. Ko wampaye itongo i Negebu, mpa n’amariba y’amazi.” Nuko Kalebu amuha amariba yo hepfo n’ayo haruguru.

Abakomoka kuri sebukwe wa Mose, ari bo Bakayini, badugana n’abo mu muryango wa Yuda bava i Yeriko, ari co gisagara c’ibigazi, babana n’ababa mu bugaragwa bw’i Buyuda, hafi y’igisagara ca Aradi i Negebu.
Hanyuma abo mu muryango wa Yuda bifatanya n’abo mu muryango wa Simeyoni, batera Abanyakanani baba i Zefati, basambura igisagara cabo cose. Ico gisagara baca bacita Horuma.
Abo mu muryango wa Yuda bongera bafata Gaza, Ashikeloni na Ekuroni, hamwe n’uturere tuhakikuje.
Uhoraho abana n’abo mu muryango wa Yuda, maze bafata igice co mu misozi, ariko ntibashobora kwirukana ababa mu biyaya, kuko bari bafise imikogote y’ivyuma.
Igisagara ca Heburoni gihabwa Kalebu nk’uko Mose yari yarabisezeranye, Kalebu na we aca yirukana abahaba, ari bo ruvyaro rw’abahungu batatu ba Anaki.
Ariko abo mu muryango wa Benyamini ntibashobora kwirukana Abayebusi baba i Yerusalemu, ari co gituma gushika n’ubu Abayebusi babana n’abo mu muryango wa Benyamini.
Imiryango ikomoka kuri Yosefu na yo itera igisagara ca Beteli, kandi Uhoraho abana na bo.
Nuko barungika abantu baja gutata igisagara ca Beteli, cahoze citwa Luzi.
Abo batasi babonye umuntu ava muri ico gisagara, baramubwira bati: “Twereke ingene twokwinjira muri iki gisagara, tuzokugirira neza.”
Nuko aca arabereka, baca barinjira bicisha inkota abo muri ico gisagara bose, kiretse uwo yaberetse ingene boshika muri ico gisagara hamwe n’umuryango wiwe.
Maze uwo muntu aca aja mu ntara y’Abaheti, ahubaka igisagara, acita Luzi, kandi ni ko kicitwa gushika n’ubu.

Umuryango wa Manase na wo ntiwashoboye kwirukana abantu b’i Beti-Shani, canke ab’i Tanaki, canke ab’i Dori, canke ab’i Ibileyamu, canke ab’i Megido, canke abari bahakikuje, kuko Abanyakanani bari barahiye ko bazoguma baba muri iyo ntara.
Abisirayeli bamaze gukomera, baca bagira Abanyakanani abagurano, ariko ntibigeze babirukana bose muri iyo ntara.
N’abo mu muryango wa Efurayimu ntibashoboye kwirukana Abanyakanani baba i Gezeri, bagumye babana na bo.
Ndetse n’abo mu muryango wa Zebuloni na bo nyene ntibashoboye kwirukana Abanyakanani baba i Kitironi n’i Nahaloli, bagumye babana na bo, ariko ntibabagize abagurano.
N’abo mu muryango wa Asheri ntibashoboye kwirukana ababa muri Ako, canke ab’i Sidoni, canke ab’i Ahalabu, canke abo muri Akizibu, canke ab’i Helubaho canke abo muri Afiki, canke ab’i Rehobu.
Ahubwo abo mu muryango wa Asheri bagiye kubana n’Abanyakanani baganza iyo ntara, kuko bananiwe kubirukana.

Abo mu muryango wa Nafutali na bo nyene ntibashoboye kwirukana ababa i Beti-Shemeshi canke i Beti-Anati. Na bo nyene babanye n’Abanyakanani baba muri iyo ntara, ariko ababa i Beti-Shemeshi n’i Beti-Anati babagira abagurano babo.
Abo mu muryango wa Dani, Abamori barabirukanye baja mu karere k’imisozi, ntibabemerera ko bamanuka mu biyaya.
Abamori bari bararahiye ko bazoguma ku misozi Hari-Haresi, Ayaloni na Shayalubimu, ariko abo mu muryango wa Yosefu bamaze kugwira, baciye babagira abagurano.
Urubibe rw’Abamori rwava ku mudugo wa Akurabimu rugashika i Sela, rukabandanya ruja ruguru.

Umumarayika w’ Uhoraho aduga ava i Gilugali aja i Bokimu, avuga ati: “Nabaduganye ndabakuye muri Egiputa ndabashikana mu gihugu narahiye ko nzoha ba sogokuruza banyu. Naravuze ko ntazorenga kw’isezerano nagiranye na bo.
Ku ruhande rwanyu mwemeye ko mutazogirana isezerano na rimwe n’ababa muri iki gihugu, mwemera ko muzosangangura ibicaniro vyabo. Ariko ntimwanyumviye. Mbega ivyo mwabitumwe n’iki?
None rero ndababwiye ko ntazobirukana imbere yanyu. Bazobabera nk’amahwa abacumita mu mbavu, imana zabo na zo zibabere imitego.”
Uwo mumarayika w’ Uhoraho amaze kubwira Abisirayeli bose ivyo, abantu baraturikisha bararira.
Aho hantu baca bahita Bokimu, bisigura “Kurira”, baca bahashikanira Uhoraho ibimazi.
Yosuwa amaze kurungika Abisirayeli, baciye baja gufata igihugu, umuryango wose uja gufata aho wahawe.
Abantu bakorera Uhoraho mu gihe cose Yosuwa yari akiriho no mu gihe c’abatware bakoranye na we, abo yasize amaze gupfa, abari barabonye ibikomeye Uhoraho yari yarakoreye Isirayeli.
Yosuwa mwene Nuni, umusavyi w’ Uhoraho , apfa amaze imyaka ijana na cumi.
Bamuhamba mw’itongo yagabanye i Timunati-Hereki, mu ntara yo mu misozi ya Efurayimu, mu buraruko bw’umusozi Gayashi.
Urwo runganwe rumaze guhamvya ba sekuruza, haza urundi rutari rwarigeze rumenya Uhoraho canke ngo rubone ivyo Uhoraho yakoreye Isirayeli.
Nuko Abisirayeli bakora ibibi mu maso y’ Uhoraho , bongera bakorera ibigirwamana vyitwa Bayali.
Bava k’ Uhoraho , Imana ya ba sekuruza babo, yabakuye muri Egiputa, bakurikira imana zitandukanye z’abantu babana na bo, barazisenga. Ivyo bituma uburake bw’ Uhoraho buziriringa,
kuko bari bayivuyeko bagakorera ibigirwamana Bayali na Ashitaroti.
Ivyo bituma Uhoraho arakira Isirayeli, abarekuriramwo abasuma babanyaga ivyabo. Abagurisha ku bansi babo bari babakikuje kuko batari bagishoboye kubagwanya.
Igihe cose Abisirayeli baja kugwana, ukuboko kw’ Uhoraho kwarabagwanya bakaneshwa nk’uko yari yarabisezeranye. Nuko baja mu kwihebura gukomeye.
Hanyuma Uhoraho ahagurutsa abacamanza, barokora Abisirayeli mu maboko y’abari barabanyaze.
Ariko Abisirayeli ntibumvira abo bacamanza, ahubwo bashira imitima ku zindi mana, barazisenga. Nuko bihutira kuva mu nzira za ba sekuruza kuko bobo bagendera mu kwumvira ivyagezwe vy’ Uhoraho .

Igihe cose Uhoraho yabahagurukiriza umucamanza, yabana na we akabarokora mu maboko y’abansi babo igihe cose uwo mucamanza yaba akiriho, kuko Uhoraho yaterwa akagongwe n’amaborogo avuye ku gacinyizo bagirirwa n’abansi babo.

Ariko uwo mucamanza amaze gupfa, abantu baca basubira gukora ibibi biruta n’ivya ba sekuruza, bagakurikira izindi mana, bakazikorera bakongera bakazisenga. Banka guheba ibikorwa vyabo bibi n’ubugarariji bwabo.
Ni co catumye Uhoraho arakira Isirayeli cane, avuga ati: “Ko ubu bwoko bwarenze isezerano nagiranye na ba sekuruza babo, bakanka gukurikiza amabwirizwa yanje,
nta hanga na rimwe Yosuwa yapfuye atanesheje nzokwirukana imbere yabo.
Nzokoresha ayo mahanga mu kugerageza Abisirayeli kugira ngo ndabe ko boguma mu nzira z’ Uhoraho , bakagenda nk’uko ba sekuruza bagenda.”
Ni co gituma Uhoraho yaretse ayo mahanga akagumaho, ntiyigera ayirukana canke ngo yemere ko Yosuwa ayamara yose.
Aya ni yo mahanga Uhoraho yasigaje kugira ngo agerageze Abisirayeli batagwanye intambara n’imwe mu zabereye i Kanani.
Ayo yayasigaje kugira ngo yigishe intambara uruvyaro rwa Isirayeli rutigeze ruja mu ntambara.

Ayo mahanga na yo ni aya: Abafilisitiya bari barongowe n’abatware batanu, Abanyakanani bose, Abanyesidoni hamwe n’Abahiwi baba mu misozi ya Libani kuva ku musozi Bayali-Herumoni gushika i Lebo-Hamati.
Ayo mahanga yasigajwe ngo agerageze Isirayeli, kugira ngo Uhoraho arabe ko bazokurikiza amabwirizwa yahaye ba sekuruza aciye kuri Mose.
Abisirayeli babana n’Abanyakanani, Abaheti, Abamori, Abaperizi, Abahiwi n’Abayebusi,
bahana abageni, bongera bakorera imana zabo.
Abisirayeli bakora ivyo Uhoraho abona ko ari bibi mu maso yiwe, bibagira Uhoraho Imana yabo, bakorera Bayali na Ashera.
Uburake bw’ Uhoraho buziriringira Isirayeli, abatanga ku mwami Kushani Rishatayimu w’i Mezopotamiya, bamubera abagurano imyaka umunani.
Hanyuma baririra Uhoraho ngo abatabare, na we abahagurukiriza uwubacungura, ari we Otiniyeli mwene Kenazi, Kenazi murumuna wa Kalebu, maze arabarokora.
Mpwemu w’ Uhoraho aza kuri we, aba umucamanza w’Abisirayeli. Atera umwami Kushani Rishatayimu wa Aramu, Uhoraho amurekurira mu maboko ya Otiniyeli, aramunesha.
Igihugu gica kimara imyaka mirongo ine kiri mu mahoro, gushika Otiniyeli mwene Kenazi apfuye.
Abisirayeli bongera gukora ivyo Uhoraho abona ko ari bibi mu maso yiwe, bituma Uhoraho aha umwami Eguloni w’i Mowabu ububasha bwo kuganza Isirayeli.
Eguloni akoranya Abamoni n’Abamaleki ngo bamufashe kugwanya Abisirayeli. Nuko barabatera barabanesha, bafata Yeriko, ari co gisagara c’ibigazi.
Abisirayeli bakorera Eguloni umwami w’i Mowabu imyaka icumi n’umunani.

Abisirayeli basubira kuririra Uhoraho ngo abatabare, na we abahagurukiriza uwundi mucunguzi, ari we Ehudi mwene Gera, yakoresha ibampfu akaba uwo mu muryango wa Benyamini. Abisirayeli bamurungikana ikori kuri Eguloni umwami wa Mowabu.
Ehudi yari yaracuze inkota y’ubugi bubiri yangana n’ingero y’igice c’ukuboko imwe, ayibohera kw’itako ry’i buryo, ayambarirako.
Nuko ashikanira iryo kori Eguloni umwami wa Mowabu, kandi yari avyibushe cane.
Ehudi ahejeje kurimuha, we n’abari baje barizanye baca basubira inyuma.

Bashitse i Gilugali aho basengera ibigirwamana vy’ibuye, aca asubira inyuma, abwira umwami ati: “Nyenicubahiro, ndafise ubutumwa bw’ibanga ndakuzaniye.” Umwami na we aca abwira abatware biwe bose ati: “Nimudutaramukire tubonane.”
Nuko Ehudi aramwegera aho yari yicaye wenyene mu cumba co hejuru mu kirimba, amubwira ati: “Ndagufitiye ubutumwa buvuye ku Mana.” Wa mwami aca arahaguruka aho yari yicaye,
Ehudi na we aramvura ukuboko kwiwe kw’ukubamfu afata ya nkota yari iboheye kw’itako ry’i buryo, ayisogota mu nda y’uwo mwami.
N’ikirindi cayo kirinjira, iserukira mu mugongo. Ehudi ntiyayisokora, ibinure vyiwe birayipfuka.
Ehudi aca asiga yugariye imbere umuryango w’ico cumba, na we asohokana mu bwiherero.
Amaze kugenda, abakozi b’uwo mwami baraza basanga umuryango w’ico cumba wugariye imbere. Ni ko kwibaza ko umwami yoba yari ari kwihagarika.
Nuko bararindira, ariko bashika aho bagira amakenga babonye umwami atugurura.
Bakirindiriye, Ehudi afata inzira arigira. Aca i ruhande ya ca kibanza basengeramwo ibigirwamana, aja i Seyira.
Ashitseyo mu ntara y’imisozi ya Efurayimu, aca avuza inzamba y’intambara. Abisirayeli baca bamanukana na we, aba ari we abarongora.

Ababwira ati: “Nimunkurikire, kuko Uhoraho yarekuriye mu maboko yanyu umwansi wanyu ari we Mowabu.” Nuko baramukurikira, baramanuka, bafata amajabukiro yose yo kuri Yorodani ava i Mowabu, kugira ngo ntihagire n’umwe ajabuka.
Nuko batera Mowabu, bica abantu ibihumbi cumi mu basoda bakomeye kandi b’inguvu, ntihagira n’umwe acika kw’icumu.
Uwo musi nyene Mowabu gihinduka intara yigaruriwe na Isirayeli, igihugu cose gica kimara imyaka mirongo umunani kiri mu mahoro.
Inyuma ya Ehudi haje Shamugari mwene Anati, ari na we yishe Abafilisitiya amajana atandatu abicishije igisonga. Nuko na we yabaye umutabazi w’Abisirayeli.
Ehudi amaze gupfa Abisirayeli bongera gukora ivyo Uhoraho abona ko ari bibi mu maso yiwe.
Maze Uhoraho abarekurira mu maboko ya Yabini, umwami wa Kanani yaba i Hazori. Sisera ni we yari arongoye ingabo ziwe, na we akaba yaba i Harosheti-Hagoyimu.
Sisera yari afise imikogote amajana icenda kandi yatwaje umukazo Abisirayeli imyaka mirongo ibiri. Maze Abisirayeli baririra Uhoraho ngo abatabare.
Hariho umugore yitwa Debora, umugore wa Lapidoti, yari umuvugishwa kandi ni we yari umucamanza w’Abisirayeli ico gihe.
Yacira imanza musi y’ikigazi ca Debora hagati ya Rama na Beteli mu karere k’imisozi ya Efurayimu, Abisirayeli bakama baza aho ari ngo abatunganirize iyo bafise amatati.

Umusi umwe atumako Baraki mwene Abinowamu yaba i Kedeshi mu ntara ya Nafutali, amubwira ati: “ Uhoraho Imana ya Isirayeli akubwiye ati: ‘Genda wegeranye abasoda ibihumbi cumi bo mu ba Nafutali no mu ba Zebuloni, ubatware ku musozi Tabori.
Nanje nzokwega Sisera, umukuru w’ingabo za Yabini, hamwe n’imikogote yiwe n’abasoda biwe, baze ku ruzi Kishoni. Aho ni ho nzomurekurira mu maboko yawe.’ ”
Baraki aramwishura ati: “Nitwajana nzogenda, ariko nitutajana sinzogenda.”
Debora amwishura ati: “Nta co tuzojana. Ariko tujanye, nta cubahiro bizoguha kuko intsinzi y’ Uhoraho kuri Sisera izoba ishizwe mu maboko y’umugore.” Nuko Debora ajana na Baraki i Kedeshi.
Bashitseyo, Baraki akoranya imiryango ya Zebuloni na Nafutali. Abasoda ibihumbi cumi baramukurikira, na Debora ajana na we.
Hariho umuntu yitwa Heberi w’Umukayini yari yaravuye mu bandi Bakayini bo mu ruvyaro rwa Hobabu, muramu wa Mose, ashinga ihema ryiwe hafi y’igiti kinini c’i Zayananimu hafi y’i Kedeshi.
Sisera yumvise ko Baraki mwene Abinowamu yaduze ku musozi Tabori,
aca yegeranya imikogote yiwe yose amajana icenda hamwe n’abagwanyi biwe, baca bafata urugendo bava i Harosheti-Hagoyimu baja ku ruzi Kishoni.

Maze Debora abwira Baraki ati: “Itegure! Uyu ni wo musi Uhoraho yarekuriye Sisera mu maboko yawe, kandi Uhoraho agendera imbere yawe.” Nuko Baraki ajana abasoda biwe ibihumbi cumi, bamanuka umutumba Tabori baja kugwana.
Baraki ateye Sisera, Uhoraho na we amuca ivutu hamwe n’imikogote yiwe n’abagwanyi biwe bose, Sisera aca ava mu mukogote ahunga yiruka n’amaguru.
Ariko Baraki akurikira iyo mikogote n’abo basoda gushika i Harosheti-Hagoyimu. Abasoda ba Sisera bose bamarwa n’inkota, ntihasigara n’uwo kuvuga inkuru.
Ariko Sisera we ahunga yiruka n’amaguru, ashikira ihema rya Yayeli muka Heberi Umukayini, kuko uwo muryango wari ufitaniye ubucuti na Yabini umwami wa Hazori.
Yayeli asohoka gusanganira Sisera, amubwira ati: “Kaze nyakwubahwa. Kandi ntihagire ico utinya.” Nuko aca yinjira muri iryo hema, Yayeli amupfuka uburengeti.
Sisera amubwira ati: “Ndanyotewe. Impa amazi yo kunywa.” Aca amuha umukuza warimwo amata, aranywa, aca arasubira aramupfuka.
Sisera amubwira ati: “Hagarara mu muryango w’ihema, nihagira uwuza akakubaza ati: ‘Hari umuntu yinjiye ngaha?’ Uvuge uti: ‘Oya.’ ”

Ariko Yayeli muka Heberi aca ahitana urumambo rw’ihema n’inyundo, yinjira bukebuke, yinjira aho Sisera yari aryamye asinziriye cane kuko yari yarushe. Aca amushinga rwa rumambo rw’ihema mu mutwe, ararushimangira gushika hasi, Sisera aca arapfa.

Baraki ashitse ariko arakurikira Sisera, Yayeli aramutegera, amubwira ati: “Ingo ndakwereke uwo uriko urarondera.” Aca yinjirana na we aho Sisera yari aryamye, na rwa rumambo rw’ihema rushinze mu mutwe, yapfuye.
Uwo musi Imana inesha Yabini umwami w’Umunyakanani, imbere y’Abisirayeli.
Kuva ico gihe, Abisirayeli basumvya inkomezi Yabini umwami w’Umunyakanani, gushika aho bamurandura.
Uwo musi Debora na Baraki mwene Abinowamu baca bariririmba indirimbo bavuga bati:
“Nimuhimbaze Uhoraho , kuko habonetse intwari zirongora Isirayeli, abantu bakitanga batagoberewe.
Nimwumve yemwe bami, mutege amatwi namwe batware! Ngira ndirimbire Uhoraho , ncurarangire Uhoraho , Imana ya Isirayeli.
Ewe Uhoraho , igihe wava i Seyiri, ukagendagenda uvuye mu ntara ya Edomu, isi yaratigise, ijuru rirajojota, ibicu bisesa amazi.
Imitumba yanyiganyigiye imbere y’ Uhoraho , Imana y’i Sinayi, imbere y’ Uhoraho Imana ya Isirayeli ni ho yatigitiye.
Mu gihe ca Shamugari mwene Anati, no mu gihe ca Yayeli, abantu ntibari bagica mu mabarabara, n’ingenzi zaca mu tuyira dutoduto duca kure.
Abo mu bisagara vya Isirayeli ntibashobora kugwana; gushika aho jewe Debora mpagurukiye, mpaguruka nk’umuvyeyi wa Isirayeli.
Igihe bihitiramwo izindi mana, intambara yinjiye mu marembo y’igisagara, nta nkinzo canke icumu ryaboneka mu Bisirayeli mu bihumbi mirongo ine vy’ingabo.
Umutima wanje uri kumwe n’abarongozi ba Isirayeli, n’abitanze bo mu bwoko ngo baje mu ntambara. Uhoraho nashimwe!
Yemwe abagendera ku ndogoba z’igitare, na mwebwe mwiyicariye ku mikeka myiza, namwe mugendera mu mabarabara, nimutege amatwi
indirimbo z’abungere bari ku ngomero. Bavuga intsinzi ziva ku kugororoka kw’ Uhoraho , hamwe n’intsinzi y’Abisirayeli. Maze abantu baca baramanuka, baja ku marembo y’ibisagara.
Kanguka, kanguka Debora! Kanguka, shirako uririmbe! Kanguka, yewe Baraki! Gira imbohe abanyagano bawe, yewe mwene Abinowamu!
Amasigarira y’abubahwa baramanutse, ubwoko bw’ Uhoraho bwaje aho ndi ngo buhangane n’abanyenkomezi.
Bamwe baje bava mu ba Efurayimu, abatsinze Amaleki; Ababenyamini bari kumwe nawe bagukurikiye. Abakuru mu basoda bamanutse bava i Makiri, abatanga amategeko na bo bamanutse bava mu Bazebuloni.
Abaganwa ba Isakari na bo bari kumwe na Debora; ni ivy’ukuri aba Isakari bari kumwe na Baraki, barungikwa mu biyaya barongowe na we. Mu karere ka Reyubeni vyaranse ko bafata ingingo baguma mu mpari.
Ni kuki mwigumiye mu mpongore z’intama ngo mwumvirize urwamo rw’imikuku? Mu bakomoka kuri Reyubeni Vyaranse ko bafata ingingo.
Ab’i Gileyadi bigumiye hakurya ya Yorodani. Kandi ni kuki abakomoka kuri Dani, bigumiye mu mato yabo? Abakomoka kuri Asheri bagumye bicaye ku nkengera z’ikiyaga, bisigarira mu bivuko vyabo.
Abakomoka kuri Zebuloni bashize ubuzima bwabo mw’irinde; n’abakomoka kuri Nafutali na bo bahangana n’urugamba mu misozi.
Abami baraje baragwana, abami b’i Kanani baragwanye. I Tanaki, hafi y’amazi y’i Megido, nta feza bashoboye kunyaga.
Inyenyeri zo kw’ijuru zaragwanye, zajanye inzira zazo zigwanya Sisera.
Uruzi Kishoni rwarabatwaye bose, uruzi rwa kera cane, uruzi Kishoni! Komera, mushaha wanje, gira inkomezi!
Hanyuma humvikanye urwamo rw’ibinono vy’amafarasi, zigenda zirasimbagurika ku binono vyazo vy’inkomezi.
Umumarayika w’ Uhoraho ati: ‘Vuma Merozi. N’abantu baho bavumwe bikomeye, kuko bataje gufasha Uhoraho , gufasha Uhoraho kugwanya abanyenkomezi.’
Yayeli aragahezagirwa kurusha abandi bagore bose, Yayeli umugore wa Heberi Umukayini, ahezagirwe kurusha abagore bose baba mu mahema.
Yamusavye amazi, ariko we amuha amata; igikombe kibereye abubahwa ni co yamuzaniyemwo urubu.
Hanyuma agorora ukuboko kwiwe afata urumambo rw’ihema; ukuboko kwiwe kw’i buryo gufata inyundo y’umwubatsi. Yahonze Sisera, amumena umutwe, yaramusabije agahanga aragatobekeranya.
Imbere y’ibirenge vyiwe Sisera arayama, aratemba, ararambarara. Imbere y’ibirenge vyiwe arayama, aratemba; aho yayamiye, ni ho yatemvye, aracikana.
Nyina wa Sisera yagumye arabira mw’idirisha; mu ntoboro zaryo agasemerera ati: ‘Ni kuki umukogote wiwe utevye gushika? Ni kuki umurindi w’imigote yiwe utevye kwumvikana?’
Abagore b’incabwenge baramwishura; na we aguma yibwira ati:

‘Mbega ntibakiriko baratora bongera bagabura isahu: umugabo umwe wese afata umugore umwe canke babiri, impuzu z’amabara nk’isahu rya Sisera; impuzu z’amabara zisharijwe ku mpande, impuzu zisharijwe cane ku rundi ruhande, izo nzokwambara mw’izosi, izo zose zivuye mw’isahu.’
Uhoraho , abansi bawe bose baragahona! Ariko abagukunda bose barakamera nk’izuba iyo riserukanye inkomezi zaryo.” Nuko igihugu kimara imyaka mirongo ine kiri mu mahoro.
Abisirayeli basubira gukora ibibi mu maso y’ Uhoraho , maze aca abarekurira mu maboko y’Abamidiyani babategeka imyaka indwi.
Kubera agacinyizo k’Abamidiyani kari kenshi, vyatumye Abisirayeli baja kwinyegeza mu bihomoka vy’imitumba, mu masenga, no mu bindi bibundo.
Igihe cose Abisirayeli baba barimye imirima yabo, Abamidiyani, Abamaleki hamwe n’amahanga yo mu buseruko baca batera Isirayeli,
bagacumbika muri ico gihugu gushika imirima yabo yose bayihoneje kuva ngaho gushika mu gisagara ca Gaza. Basiga Abisirayeli batagira ico barya, ata ntama canke indogoba n’imwe basigaranye.

Abo bansi babo bazanana n’ibitungwa vyabo, bagashinga n’amahema yabo. Baza kubatera ari isinzi nk’inzige ziteye. Baje ku ngamiya zabo ari benshi cane ku buryo ata muntu yashobora kubaharura, basiga basanganguye igihugu rwose.
Abamidiyani batera ubukene Abisirayeli gushika aho baririra Uhoraho ngo abatabare.
Abisirayeli bamaze kuririra Uhoraho kubera Abamidiyani,
aca arungikira umuvugishwa Abisirayeli, ababwira ati: “ Uhoraho Imana ya Isirayeli avuze ati: Ni jewe nabakuye mu buja bwa Egiputa.
Nabarokoye mu bubasha bwa Egiputa, mu gihugu mwarimwo mucunaguzwa. Nirukana abansi banyu, ndabaha igihugu cabo.
Narababwiye nti: ‘Ndi Uhoraho Imana yanyu. Ntimuzosenge imana z’Abamori, bene iki gihugu mubamwo.’ Ariko ntimwanyumviye.”

Uwo mumarayika w’ Uhoraho aca aja kwicara musi y’igiti kinini c’i Ofura, cari ica Yowashi wo mu muryango wa Abiyezeri. Gidiyoni mwene Yowashi yariko arasekuririra ingano mu bwato azinyegeje Abamidiyani.
Wa mumarayika w’ Uhoraho yiyereka Gidiyoni, amubwira ati: “ Uhoraho ari kumwe nawe, wa muhizi w’umunyenkomezi.”

Gidiyoni arishura ati: “Nyakwubahwa, nimba Uhoraho ari kumwe natwe, ni kubera iki ibi vyose biriko biradushikira? Mbega vya bitangaza ba sogokuruza bacu bavuga aho batubwira bati: ‘ Uhoraho ni we yadukuye muri Egiputa,’ biri hehe? Ko mbona ubu Uhoraho yadutaye, akaturekurira mu maboko y’Abamidiyani.”
Uhoraho arahindukira amubwira ati: “Jana izo nkomezi nyene ufise, ukize Abisirayeli mu maboko y’Abamidiyani. Ni jewe nkurungitse!”
Ariko Gidiyoni yishura ati: “Mwami, jewe norokora Abisirayeli bigenze gute? Umuryango wanje ni wo muryango wa nyuma mu miryango ya Manase, kandi nanje ndi inyuma y’abandi bose mu muryango wanje.”
Uhoraho aramubarira ati: “Nzoba ndi kumwe nawe, kandi Abamidiyani uzobarandura nk’uwugwanya umuntu umwe.”
Gidiyoni yishura ati: “Nimba nagiriwe ubuntu mu nyonga zawe, nyereka ikimenyetso kinyemeza koko ko ari Uhoraho avuganye nanje.
Ndakwinginze undindire gushika ngaruke, nzane ishikanwa ndagushikanire.” Uhoraho aramwishura ati: “Egome genda, ndakurindira gushika ugarutse.”

Gidiyoni yinjira mu nzu, ategura umwagazi w’impene, atora n’ingero efa y’ifu mu giseke, acumba imikate itagira umwambiro. Aca ashira za nyama n’umufa wazo mu gakono, azishikanira wa mumarayika aho yari yicaye musi y’igiti kinini.
Wa mumarayika w’Imana amubwira ati: “Fata izo nyama n’iyo mikate itambiye, ubishire ku gitandara, uce ubisukako uwo mufa.” Gidiyoni abigenza gutyo.
Wa mumarayika w’ Uhoraho aca abikozako umutwe w’inkoni yari yitwaje. Haca haduka umuriro uva muri ico gitandara, utongora ivyo yari yazanye vyose. Wa mumarayika w’ Uhoraho aca arazimangana.
Gidiyoni abonye ko yari umumarayika w’ Uhoraho aca araboroga avuga ati: “Ewe Uhoraho Nyeninganji, mbonye ibara kuko mbonye Umumarayika w’ Uhoraho amaso mu yandi.”
Ariko Uhoraho aramuhumuriza ati: “Tekana, ntutinye. Nta co uba!”
Aho hantu Gidiyoni aca ahubakira Uhoraho igicaniro, acita Yahwe Shalomu, bisobanura ngo Uhoraho ni we Mahoro. Ico gicaniro kiracahagaze muri Ofura mu Babiyezeri gushika n’ubu.

Iryo joro Uhoraho abarira Gidiyoni ati: “Fata impfizi igira kabiri mu nka za so, irya imaze imyaka indwi. Uce usenyagura igicaniro so yubakiye Bayali, utemagure n’inkingi ya Ashera iri i ruhande yaco.
Hanyuma uce wubaka igicaniro ciza c’ Uhoraho Imana yawe kuri uwu musozi. Uheze utange impfizi igira kabiri nk’ikimazi gituriwe kandi inkwi uzokoresha zibe iz’inkingi za Ashera watemaguye.”
Nuko Gidiyoni ahitana abakozi biwe icumi, abikora nk’uko Uhoraho yari yabimubwiye. Ariko yabikoze mw’ijoro kuko yatinya abo mu muryango wiwe hamwe n’abandi bo mu gisagara cabo.

Abantu bo muri ico gisagara bikanguye mu gatondo, basanga igicaniro ca Bayali casanganguwe, n’inkingi za Ashera yari i ruhande yaco bazitemaguriye hasi, basanga na ya mpfizi igira kabiri yatanzwe ku gicaniro gishasha.
Barabazanya bati: “Ni nde yakoze ibi?” Batohoje neza bumva ko ari Gidiyoni mwene Yowashi yabigize.
Abantu bo muri ico gisagara baca babwira Yowashi bati: “Sohokana uwo muhungu wawe. Ategerezwa gupfa kuko yasenyuye igicaniro ca Bayali, agatemagura n’inkingi za Ashera yari impande yaco.”

Ariko Yowashi yishura abo bantu bari bamugumukanye ati: “Mbega mugira muburanire Bayali? Mugomba kuyirokora? Uwugwanira Bayali wese buza guca yapfuye. Nimba Bayali ari imana y’ukuri, niyigwanire yonyene, irandure uwasenyuye igicaniro cayo.”
Uwo musi Gidiyoni baca bamwita Yerubayali, bisigura ngo “Reka Bayali yigwanire”, kuko yasenyuye igicaniro ca Bayali.
Hanyuma y’ivyo Abamidiyani, Abamaleki, n’abandi bo mu buseruko baja hamwe ngo bagwanye Isirayeli, bajabuka Yorodani, bashinga amahema yabo mu kiyaya ca Yezireyeli.
Maze Mpwemu w’ Uhoraho aza kuri Gidiyoni, aca avuza inzamba ihamagarira abantu mu ntambara, maze abo mu muryango wa Abiyezeri baramukurikira.
Aca arungika intumwa ku bo mu miryango ya Manase, Asheri, Zebuloni na Nafutali, abahamagarira kuja ku rugamba, na bo baramukurikira.
Gidiyoni asenga Imana avuga ati: “Nimba uza gukirisha Abisirayeli ukuboko kwanje nk’uko wabisezeranye,

nuvyerekanishe iki kimenyetso: ehe nshize ubwoya bw’intama ku mbuga yo gusekurirako ingano. Ejo mu gatondo nitwasanga ubu bwoya bwatoteshejwe n’urume bwonyene ariko isi yumutse, nzoheza nemere ko uzokirisha Isirayeli ukuboko kwanje nk’uko wabivuze.”
Bigenda uko. Gidiyoni avyuka kare mu gatondo, akanya bwa bwoya, buvamwo urume rwinshi, rwokwuzura akabakure.

Gidiyoni aca abwira Imana ati: “Ntunkarire, ariko reka nongere ngusabe iki kimwe. Unyemerere ndagusabe ikindi kimenyetso kuri ubu bwoya. Ubu na ho, ubu bwoya buzogume bwumye, ariko urume rutose ahabukikuje hose.”
Iryo joro Imana ibikora uko. Ubwoya bwonyene buguma bwumutse, ariko isi yuzurako urume.
Bukeye mu gatondo ka kare, Yerubayali ari we Gidiyoni hamwe n’abasoda biwe bose bashinga amahema kw’iriba ry’i Harodi. Ikambi y’Abamidiyani yari ruguru yabo mu kiyaya kiri hafi y’umusozi More.
Uhoraho abarira Gidiyoni ati: “Ufise abasoda benshi cane. Hamwe nobareka bose ngo baje kugwanya Abamidiyani, Abisirayeli bohava bishira hejuru, bakavuga ko inkomezi zabo ari zo zabahaye intsinzi.
None rero, barira abantu bose uti: ‘Uwumva afise ubwoba wese nave kuri uno musozi atahe iwe.’ ” Abantu ibihumbi mirongo ibiri na bibiri baca basubira inyuma, hasigara ibihumbi cumi gusa.
Ariko Uhoraho abarira Gidiyoni ati: “N’ubu baracari benshi. Bamanukane ku mazi, ndaza kubisuzumira, ndakwereke abo mujana ku rugamba n’abo mutajana.”

Nuko Gidiyoni amanukana ba bantu bose ku mazi. Uhoraho amubwirira kuri ayo mazi ati: “Uraraba utandukanye abantu mu mice ibiri. Abayora amazi bakayanywesha ururimi ku mashi nka kurya kw’imbwa, baje mu mugwi umwe, abapfukama bakayanywesha umunwa na bo baje mu wundi mugwi.”
Abantu amajana atatu ni bo bayayoje iminwe, abandi na bo barapfukama mu kunywa.
Uhoraho abarira Gidiyoni ati: “Nzobarokora nongere ndabahe intsinzi ku Bamidiyani nkoresheje abo amajana atatu bayoje amazi iminwe. Abandi barungike basubire mu mihana iwabo.”

Gidiyoni aca arungika Abisirayeli basubira iwabo, asigarana abo amajana atatu, ariko basigarana impamba n’inzamba vy’abo basubiye inyuma. Ico gihe ikambi y’Abamidiyani yari mu kiyaya hepfo y’aho Gidiyoni yari ari.
Muri iryo joro, Uhoraho abarira Gidiyoni ati: “Haguruka ugende utere ikambi y’Abamidiyani, kuko nabarekuriye mu maboko yawe.
Ariko nimba wumva ufise ubwoba, hitana umukozi wawe Pura, muje kw’ikambi y’Abamidiyani.
Nimwumva ivyo bavuga, birabatera intege mubatere.” Nuko Gidiyoni ahitana Pura, baramanuka baja ku mpande z’ikambi y’Abamidiyani.
Abamidiyani, Abamaleki, n’abandi bose bari bavuye mu buseruko, bakoranira mu kiyaya bangana n’igitero c’inzige, ingamiya zabo zangana n’umusenyi wo ku kiyaga, ata woziharura.

Gidiyoni ahashitse aca yumva umuntu ariko yiganira mugenziwe indoto yagize, avuga ati: “Naronse mbona irobe ry’umutsima ritembagarira mw’ikambi y’Abamidiyani, ryikubita kw’ihema, ihema riratemba, rigwa ryubamye, rica rirasambuka.”
Wa mugenzi wiwe aca amwishura ati: “Ivyo si ibindi, ni inkota ya Gidiyoni mwene Yowashi, Umwisirayeli. Imana yarekuriye Abamidiyani hamwe n’ikambi yose mu maboko yiwe.”
Gidiyoni yumvise iyo ndoto n’ukuntu bayisiguye, ahimbaza Imana. Aca asubira mw’ikambi y’Abisirayeli, asemerera avuga ati: “Haguruka tugende, kuko Uhoraho aduhaye intsinzi ku Bamidiyani.”
Aca agabura abo bantu amajana atatu mu migwi itatu, umuntu wese amuha inzamba n’akabindi karimwo ikimuri.
Ababwira ati: “Muje kuguma muraba ivyo nkora vyose. Nitwashika ku mahema ya mbere, ivyo nja gukora namwe abe ari vyo mukora.
Jewe n’abo turi kumwe nitwavuza inzamba abakikuje ikambi mwese muce muvuza izanyu, musemerere muti: ‘Ku bw’ Uhoraho no ku bwa Gidiyoni.’ ”
Gidiyoni na bamwe ijana bari kumwe na we bashika ku nsago za mbere, umuteramyi wa mbere ari ho agiheza, bavyuye uwa kabiri. Baca bavuza inzamba, bamenagura na twa tubindi bari bafise mu minwe.
Ya migwi itatu yose ica ivuza inzamba, imenagura na twa tubindi. Bafata vya bimuri mu kubamfu, mu kuryo na ho bafata za nzamba, bose barasemerera bati: “Fata inkota ku bw’ Uhoraho na Gidiyoni!”
Umuntu wese yagumye ahagaze aho yari ari bakikuje ikambi, Abamidiyani bose bahunga bakoma induru.

Bamwe amajana atatu bavugije inzamba, Uhoraho aca atuma abari muri iryo kambi bahindukiriranira, bamaranisha inkota zabo. Abacitse kw’icumu bahungira i Beti-Shita ahaherereye i Zerera, bashika ku rubibe rwa Abeli-Mehola hafi ya Tabati.
Gidiyoni aca atumako abo mu miryango ya Nafutali, Asheri, hamwe n’Abamanase bose, bakurikira Abamidiyani.

Gidiyoni atumako n’abo mu karere k’imisozi ya Efurayimu ababwira ati: “Nimumanuke tugwanye Abamidiyani. Mubatangirire kuri Yorodani ku majabukiro y’i Beti-Bara.” Nuko Abefurayimu babikora nk’uko babwiwe.

Bafata abarongozi babiri b’Abamidiyani, Orebu na Zeyebu. Bicira Orebu ku gitandara ca Orebu, Zeyebu na we bamwicira kw’ibuye rya Zeyebu. Bakurikira Abamidiyani, bazanira Gidiyoni n’imitwe ya Orebu na Zeyebu aho yari ari kuri Yorodani.
Abo mu muryango wa Efurayimu babaza Gidiyoni bati: “Mbega ni iki watugaye catumye udufata uko? Ni kubera iki utaduhamagaye ngo tujane igihe waja gutera Abamidiyani?” Baramwidodombera cane.
Ariko arabishura ati: “Mbega jewe maze iki mungereranije na mwebwe? Mbega imizabibu mwebwe Abefurayimu musiga yo guhumba ntisumba umwimbu wose w’Abiyezeri?
Imana yarekuriye Orebu na Zeyebu, abarongozi b’Abamidiyani, mu maboko yanyu. Jewe ni igiki nakoze gihwanye n’ico mwakoze?” Ababwiye ivyo, imyidodombo yabo ica iragabanuka.
Gidiyoni na bamwe amajana atatu bari kumwe bararuha, ariko baguma bakurikira umwansi wabo, bashika kuri Yorodani bararujabuka.
Gidiyoni abarira abantu b’i Sukoti ati: “Ndabasavye mumpere abasoda ivyokurya kuko bararushe. Ndiko nkurikira Zeba na Zalimuna, abami b’Abamidiyani.”
Ariko abatware b’i Sukoti bamwishura bati: “Mbega aho tubaha ivyokurya, Zalimuna na Zeba mwabafashe? Abasoda bawe tubahera indya iki batarabafata?”
Gidiyoni arabishura ati: “Ko munyishuye uko, Uhoraho niyamara kurekurira Zeba na Zalimuna mu maboko yanje, mwebwe nzobahindukirira imibiri yanyu ndayishishaguze amahwa yo mw’ishamba n’imibambangwe.”
Bavuye aho baca baduga i Peniyeli, basaba ivyokurya gutyo nyene, ariko abantu baho babishura nk’ab’i Sukoti.
Gidiyoni aca abwira abantu b’i Peniyeli ati: “Ninagaruka nzanye intsinzi nzosambura uwu munara.”

Zeba na Zalimuna bari i Karukori bari kumwe n’abasoda ibihumbi cumi na bitanu. Abo ni bo bari basigaye muri abo basoda bo mu buseruko bose bari bagiye hamwe, kuko abandi ibihumbi ijana na mirongo ibiri bari bamaze kugwa ku rugamba.
Nuko Gidiyoni afata ibarabara ryo mu buseruko bwa Noba na Yogibeha, ahasanga izo ngabo arazitera giturumbuka.
Zeba na Zalimuna, abami babiri b’Abamidiyani, barahunga, ariko aboma inyuma, arabafata, afata n’abasoda babo bose.
Gidiyoni mwene Yowashi aragaruka avuye ku rugamba, aca mu nzira ya Heresi.
Afata umusore ava i Sukoti, uwo musore amwandikira amazina y’abatware mirongo indwi ba Sukoti, ari bo bakuru b’ico gisagara.
Maze Gidiyoni abwira abantu b’i Sukoti ati: “Ngaba Zeba na Zalimuna, abo mwanshinyaguriza, muvuga muti: ‘Mbega Zeba na Zalimuna mwabafashe? Ni kubera iki twoha ivyokurya abantu bawe barushe?’ ”
Gidiyoni aca afata ba batware b’igisagara, arabahana, abashishaguza amahwa yo mw’ishamba n’imibambangwe.
Yongera asenyura umunara w’i Peniyeli, yica n’abatware b’ico gisagara.
Aca abaza Zeba na Zalimuna ati: “Abantu mwishe i Tabori bari bameze gute?” Na bo barishura bati: “Bari abantu bameze nk’uko kwanyu, basa n’abana b’abami.”
Gidiyoni ababwira ati: “Barya bari abavukanyi banje, abahungu bavuka kuri mama. Ndabarahiye Uhoraho , iyo muba mutabishe, nanje sinari kubica.”
Aca ahindukirira Yeteri umuhungu wiwe w’imfura, amubwira ati: “Bice!” Ariko Yeteri aratinya gufata inkota yiwe kuko yari akiri muto, ahinda agashitsi.
Zeba na Zalimuna bavuga babwira Gidiyoni bati: “Twiyicire wewe nyene, ibigumye bikora abagabo.” Nuko Gidiyoni ava hasi arabica, aca yambura ingamiya zabo ibitako vy’inyambarabami ku mazosi yazo.
Inyuma y’ivyo, Abisirayeli babwira Gidiyoni bati: “Nabe ari wewe udutwara! Abana bawe n’abuzukuru bawe bazobe abatware bacu kuko wadukuye mu maboko y’Abamidiyani.”
Ariko Gidiyoni ababwira ati: “Sinzobatwara kandi n’abana banje ntibazobatwara. Uhoraho ni we azoguma abatwara.”
Yongera ababwira ati: “Ndafise ikintu kimwe ndabasaba: umwe wese muri mwebwe ampe ihereni rimwe ku yo mwanyaze.” (Wari umugenzo mu bo kwa Ishimayeli kwambara amahereni y’inzahabu.)
Baramwishura bati: “Turemeye kuriguha ata kagobero.” Nuko basanza umutamana hasi, umuntu wese atererako ihereni rimwe mu yo yanyaze.

Amahereni y’inzahabu yaronse yapima shekeli igihumbi n’amajana indwi, ukuyemwo ibisharizo vy’inyambarabami vy’ingamiya, utugenegene two kwambara tw’inzahabu, n’impuzu z’agahama zambarwa n’abami b’Abamidiyani.
Izo nzahabu Gidiyoni azikoramwo efodi ayishira muri Ofura, mu gisagara ciwe. Ariko ubwo nyene Abisirayeli baca bakora ubusambanyi mu kuyisenga, ivyo bica biba umutego kuri Gidiyoni n’umuryango wiwe.
Uko ni ko Abisirayeli banesheje Abamidiyani, barabaganza, ntibapfa basubiriye kubiganzura. Mu yindi myaka mirongo ine Gidiyoni yabayeho, Isirayeli yari mu mahoro.
Yerubayali mwene Yowashi aca asubira i muhira iwe.
Yari afise abahungu mirongo indwi yivyariye, kuko yari afise abagore benshi.
Umugore wiwe yaba i Shekemu na we nyene yamuvyayeko umwana w’umuhungu, amwita Abimeleki.
Gidiyoni mwene Yowashi apfa ashaje cane, bamuhamba hamwe na se Yowashi muri Ofura, mu muryango w’Abiyezeri.
Gidiyoni agipfa, Abisirayeli baciye basubira gusambana mu gusenga za Bayali, bahagarika Bayali-Beriti nk’imana yabo,
bibagira Uhoraho Imana yabo yabarokoye mu maboko y’abansi bari babakikuje.
Kandi ikigeretseko, ntibigeze bafata neza umuryango wa Yerubayali ari we Gidiyoni ku bw’ivyiza vyose yabakoreye.
Umusi umwe, Abimeleki mwene Yerubayali aja kuramutsa ba inarume. Arababwira be n’abo mu muryango wa nyina bose ati:
“Nimubaze abatware b’i Shekemu muti: ‘Mbega ikibereye ni iki? Ko mwotwarwa n’abahungu mirongo indwi ba Yerubayali, canke ko mwotwarwa n’umwe?’ Kandi mwibuke ko dusangiye amaraso.”
Ba inarume babishikirije abantu b’i Shekemu, bose bemera kurongorwa na Abimeleki, kuko bavuga bati: “Ni umuvukanyi wacu.”
Baca baha Abimeleki shekeli mirongo indwi z’ifeza bakuye mu ngoro ya Bayali-Beriti, na we azikoresha mu guhemba abantu b’imburakimazi kandi b’inkozi z’ibibi bamugendanira.
Aja i muhira kwa se muri Ofura, yicira ku gitandara kimwe benewabo mirongo indwi, ari bo bahungu ba Yerubayali. Ariko Yotamu, umuhungu mutoya, aramucika kuko yari yinyegeje.
Maze ababa i Shekemu n’i Beti-Milo bose baca bakoranira musi y’igiti kinini kiri impande y’inkingi y’i Shekemu bimika Abimeleki nk’umwami.
Yotamu avyumvise, aca aduga ku musozi Gerizimu, arasemerera ati: “Nimunyumvirize yemwe batware b’i Shekemu! Nimunyumvirize nimba mushaka ko Imana ibumviriza.
Umusi umwe ibiti vyagiye kwiyimikira umwami wavyo. Ubwa mbere bibarira umwelayo biti: ‘Tubere umwami.’
Ariko umwelayo uravyishura uti: ‘Ariko noheba amavuta yanje ahesha icubahiro Imana n’abantu, ngo nze kwirirwa ndahungabana hejuru y’ibiti?’
Hanyuma bibwira umusukoni bati: ‘Ingo wewe utubere umwami.’
Ariko na wo nyene uvyishura uti: ‘Ariko noheba insukoni zanje n’ukuntu zisosa, nkirirwa ndahungabana hejuru y’ibiti?’
Ni ko kubaza umuzabibu biti: ‘Ingo wewe utubere umwami.’
Ariko umuzabibu uvyishura uti: ‘Ariko noheba umutobe wanje, uryohera Imana n’abantu, nkaja kwirirwa ndahungabana hejuru y’ibiti?’
Ubwa nyuma ibiti vyose bibwira umukere, biti: ‘Ingo utubere umwami.’

Umukere wishura ibiti uti: ‘Nimba mushaka kunyimika ngo mbe umwami wanyu vy’ukuri, nimuze muhungire musi y’igitutu canje; bitari uko, umuriro uce uza uvuye mu mukere uturire amasederi yose y’i Libani!’ ”

Yotamu abandanya ababwira ati: “None rero nimurabe neza nimba mwakoze ibibereye kandi bivuye mu kwizera mu kwimika Abimeleki nk’umwami, kandi nimba mwakoreye ibibereye Yerubayali n’umuryango wiwe, mukamufata uko bibereye.
Kuko mwibuke ko data yabagwaniye, ntiyatinyira ubuzima bwiwe kugira ngo abarokore mu maboko y’Abamidiyani.

Ariko uwu musi mwagararije data n’uruvyaro rwiwe, mwicira abahungu biwe mirongo indwi ku gitandara kimwe. Kandi mufashe umuhungu wo ku mugore w’umugurano wiwe Abimeleki aba ari we mwimika nk’umwami wa Shekemu kuko ari incuti yanyu.
None rero nimba Yerubayali n’uruvyaro rwiwe mwabakoreye ivy’icubahiro, vyiza kandi bivuye mu kwizera, nimunezerererwe Abimeleki, kandi na we nabanezerererwe.

Ariko nimba mutakoze ibikorwa vyiza bivuye mu kwizera, umuriro uce uza uvuye kuri Abimeleki ubatongore, mwebwe abatware b’i Shekemu n’i Beti-Milo, kandi umuriro uce ugenda uvuye muri mwebwe ab’i Shekemu n’i Beti-Milo, utongore Abimeleki.”
Yotamu aca arahunga aja i Beyeri, agumayo kuko yatinya mwenewabo Abimeleki.
Inyuma y’ivyo Abimeleki atwara Isirayeli imyaka itatu,
maze Imana irungika impwemu hagati ya Abimeleki n’abatware b’i Shekemu, baramuhemukira, baramugumukana.
Ivyo Imana yabikoze kugira ngo ihore ikibi bene Yerubayali bakorewe mu guseserwa amaraso na mwenewabo Abimeleki hamwe n’ab’i Shekemu bamufashije kwica benewabo.
Mu kumugarariza, abatware b’i Shekemu barungitse abantu baja kwinyegeza ku misozi hejuru, bagasahura uwurengana wese. Ariko ivyo birahava bishikira Abimeleki.
Umusi umwe Gayali mwene Ebedi aja i Shekemu ari kumwe na benewabo, maze yizerwa n’abatware b’i Shekemu.
Bamaze kuja mu mirima bakimbura inzabibu bakazigana, bagirira umusi mukuru w’iyimbura mu ngoro y’ikigirwamana cabo. Bariko bararya banywa, batangura kuvuma Abimeleki.

Gayali mwene Ebedi aravuga ati: “Mbega Abimeleki ni iki, kandi Shekemu ni iki kugira ngo tube abasavyi biwe? Mbe si mwene Yerubayali, kandi uwu Zebuli si icegera ciwe? Enda nimuze dukorere abakomoka kuri Hamori, sekuruza w’ab’i Shekemu aho gukorera Abimeleki.
Icari kumpa aba bantu nkabatwara, noca nkuraho Abimeleki. Nobwira Abimeleki nti: ‘Shaka uzanane n’ingabo zawe zose tugwane!’ ”
Zebuli umukuru w’ico gisagara yumvise ivyo Gayali mwene Ebedi avuze, ararakara cane.
Aca arungika intumwa kuri Abimeleki muri Aruma, amubwira ati: “Gayali mwene Ebedi hamwe na benewabo baje kuba i Shekemu, none bariko baragumura igisagara cose ngo bakugararize.
None rero uze guhengera mw’ijoro uzanane n’ingabo zawe, mubategerere mu gahinga.
Mu gatondo ka kare izuba rigiye guseruka muje gutera igisagara. Gayali n’ingabo ziwe nibaza kubagwanya, muze kubagira uko mushaka.”
Nuko Abimeleki n’ingabo ziwe zose bafata inzira mw’ijoro baragenda, bicamwo imigwi ine, bagira ibirindiro bikikuje Shekemu.
Gayali mwene Ebedi yari ahagaze mw’irembo ry’igisagara igihe Abimeleki n’abasoda biwe basokoroka bava aho bari binyegeje.
Gayali ababonye abarira Zebuli ati: “Ehe bariya bantu bariko baramanuka bavuye hejuru ku misozi!” Zebuli amwishura ati: “Eka si bo witiranije ibitutu vy’imisozi n’abantu.”
Ariko Gayali aramubwira ati: “Eka raba, ni abantu bariko baramanuka bavuye ku misozi, kandi uwundi mugwi na wo uriko uzanana mu nzira ica impande y’igiti ca ba kamenyi.”
Maze Zebuli aramubwira ati: “Aho wahereye wirata, reka ubu rero turabe ingene ubigenza. Ntiwavuze ngo: ‘Mbega Abimeleki ni iki aho adutwara?’ Aba si ba bantu wacokora? Genda rero ubagwanye turabe!”
Nuko Gayali asohokana abatware b’i Shekemu baja kugwanya Abimeleki.
Abimeleki aramwirukana, kandi benshi mu b’i Shekemu barakomereka, bagenda baragwa mu nzira gushika kw’irembo ry’igisagara.
Abimeleki aca asubira muri Aruma, Zebuli na we yomora Gayali na benewabo abakura mu gisagara ca Shekemu.
Ku musi ukurikira, abantu b’i Shekemu baja mu ntambara. Abimeleki abimenye,
aca agabura ingabo ziwe mu migwi itatu baja kubunda mu gahinga. Abonye basohotse igisagara, aca arahaguruka aho yari abunze, arabatera.
Abimeleki n’umugwi bari kumwe baca bihutira gutangira ku muryango w’igisagara kugira ngo abuze abagaruka mu gihe iyindi migwi yariko iratikiriza abandi mu gahinga.
Uwo musi wose Abimeleki yawumaze atera ico gisagara, gushika agifate. Aca agisanzamwo umunyu cose.
Ababa mu munara w’i Shekemu bavyumvise baca baja kwinyegeza mu ruzitiro rukomeye rw’ikibanza co gusengeramwo ibigirwamana ca Bayali-Beriti.
Abimeleki yumvise ko bakoraniyeyo,
aca aduga ku musozi Zalumoni. Aca afata ishoka, atemagura amashami y’ibiti, ayikorera ku bitugu. Aca abwira abo bari kumwe ati: “Nimunyarutse, mugire nk’uko nagize.”
Nuko bose baca amashami, bakurikira Abimeleki. Bayarundanya kuri wa munara, bawuturirana n’abantu bari muri wo. Abari muri wo bose bapfirayo, bashika nk’abantu igihumbi, abagore n’abagabo.
Mu nyuma y’aho, Abimeleki aca atera igisagara ca Tebezi, aragifata.
Ariko hagati muri ico gisagara harimwo iminara ikomakomeye abagore n’abagabo, ndetse n’abantu bose baba muri ico gisagara bayihungiramwo. Bayiyugaraniramwo baca baduga ku nsenge zayo.
Abimeleki aja kuri iyo minara arayugariza. Yegereye ku miryango yayo ngo ayiturire,
umugore yari hejuru ku munara aca amukororerako urusyo, rumumena umutwe.

Abimeleki aca abarira umugendanyi wiwe yamutwaza ibigwanisho yihuta ati: “Fata inkota yawe ningoga unyice, ntibazovuge ngo Abimeleki yishwe n’umugore!” Wa mugendanyi wiwe aca arayimusogota, aca arapfa.
Abisirayeli babonye Abimeleki apfuye, baca basubira mu mihana yabo.
Gutyo Imana iba irahanye Abimeleki kubera ikibi yakoreye se wiwe mu kugandagura benewabo mirongo indwi.
Imana yongera iba ihaniye abantu b’i Shekemu ububisha bwabo. Umuvumo wa Yotamu mwene Yerubayali ari we Gidiyoni uba urabashitseko.
Inyuma ya Abimeleki, umuntu wo mu muryango wa Isakari, yitwa Tola mwene Puwa, umwuzukuru wa Dodo, arahaguruka arokora Isirayeli. Yaba i Shamiri, mu karere k’imisozi ka Efurayimu.
Arongora Isirayeli imyaka mirongo ibiri n’itatu, hanyuma arapfa, ahambwa i Shamiri.
Tora yakurikiwe na Yayiro w’i Gileyadi, yarongoye Isirayeli imyaka mirongo ibiri n’ibiri.
Yari afise abahungu mirongo itatu, n’indogoba mirongo itatu yagenderako, kandi yaganza n’ibisagara mirongo itatu mu ntara ya Gileyadi. Ivyo bisagara biracitwa ibisagara vya Yayiro gushika n’ubu.
Yayiro apfuye, yahambwe i Kamoni.

Isirayeli isubira gukora ivyo Uhoraho abona ko ari bibi mu maso yiwe. Bakorera Bayali na Ashitaroti n’izindi mana zo muri Aramu, i Sidoni, i Mowabu, muri Amoni n’iz’Abafilisitiya. Bava k’ Uhoraho , ntibaba bakimukorera na gatoya.
Uburake bw’ Uhoraho buziriringira Abisirayeli, abarekurira mu maboko y’Abafilisitiya n’Abamoni,
batangura kubacinyiza uwo mwaka nyene. Bamara imyaka icumi n’umunani batwaza umukazo Abisirayeli baba mu buseruko bwa Yorodani, mu ntara y’Abamori ari yo Gileyadi.
Abamoni na bo nyene bajabuka Yorodani baja gutera umuryango wa Yuda, uwa Benyamini n’uwa Efurayimu; Abisirayeli bari mu gatengo gahambaye.
Maze Abisirayeli baririra Uhoraho bavuga bati: “Twaragucumuyeko, kuko twagutaye ari wewe Mana yacu, tugakorera za Bayali.”
Uhoraho arabishura ati: “Igihe Abanyegiputa, Abamori, Abamoni, Abafilisitiya,
Abanyesidoni, Abamaleki n’Abamawoni babacinyiza, ntimwandiriye nkabatabara? Sinabarokoye mu maboko yabo?
Ariko mwarantaye mukorera izindi mana. None rero singisubira kubarokora.
Nimugende muririre ziriya mana zindi mwahisemwo. Nizibe ari zo zibatabara mu marushwa yanyu!”
Ariko Abisirayeli babarira Uhoraho bati: “Twaracumuye. Duhane uko ubigomvye ariko upfe kudukiza uwu musi.”
Baca bakura imana z’inyamahanga muri bo, bakorera Uhoraho . Uhoraho ntiyaba agishobora kwihanganira amagorwa y’Abisirayeli.
Igihe Abamoni bari bakoraniye i Gileyadi ngo baje mu ntambara, Abisirayeli na bo bari bakoraniye i Misipa.
Abarongozi b’i Gileyadi babwirana bati: “Uwuza gutera Abamoni ubwa mbere ni we azoca aba umurongozi w’Abagileyadi.”
Hari umugabo yitwa Yefuta yari Umunyagileyadi, yari umugwanyi akomeye cane. Se yitwa Gileyadi, nyina akaba maraya.
Umugore wa Gileyadi yari yaravyaye n’abandi bahungu, bamaze gukura birukana Yefuta, bamubwira bati: “Nta ragi na ritoya uzoronka muri uwu muryango, kuko wavutse kuri maraya.”
Yefuta aca ahunga benewabo, aja kuba mu ntara ya Tobu, aho yasanze umugwi w’abantu b’inyererezi b’inkozi z’ibibi, baramukurikira.
Haheze igihe, Abamoni bateye Isirayeli,
abatware b’i Gileyadi batumako Yefuta mu ntara ya Tobu.
Bamubwira bati: “Ingo utubere umugabisha w’ingabo, kugira ngo dushobore kugwanya Abamoni.”
Yefuta arabishura ati: “Mbega ntimwanyanse, mukanyirukana mu nzu ya data? Ubu rero muraje kundondera ko muri mu magorwa!”
Abatware b’i Gileyadi baramubwira bati: “Ni wewe duhanze amaso! Niwaturongora muri iyi ntambara, tukagwanya Abamoni tukabatsinda, tuzokugira uwutwara ababa i Gileyadi bose.”
Yefuta arabishura ati: “Hinge twumvikane neza. Hamwe nje kugwanya Abamoni, hanyuma Uhoraho akabarekurira mu maboko yanje, muremera neza ko nzoca mba umutware wanyu?”
Ba batware bamwishura bati: “ Uhoraho ni we cabona cacu. Turemeye ko tuzobikora uko nyene ubivuze.”
Nuko Yefuta ajana n’abo batware b’i Gileyadi, bamugira umugabisha w’ingabo zose. Ageze i Misipa imbere y’ Uhoraho Yefuta asubiramwo ya majambo yose yavugana n’abatware.
Yefuta arungikira intuma umwami w’Abamoni, amubaza ati: “Mbega uturonderako iki ko uteye igihugu cacu?”

Umwami w’Abamoni na we yishura intumwa ya Yefuta ati: “Igihe Isirayeli yaduga iva muri Egiputa, banyaze intara yanje kuva ku ruzi Arunoni gushika kuri Yaboki, ukabandanya no gushika kuri Yorodani. None rero nimuhansubize mu mahoro n’umutekano.”
Yefuta asubira kurungika intumwa ku mwami w’Abamoni
avuga ati: “Uku ni ko Yefuta avuze: Isirayeli ntiyanyaze intara ya Mowabu canke y’Abamoni.
Ariko igihe bava muri Egiputa, Abisirayeli baciye mu bugaragwa baja ku Kiyaga Gitukura barabandanya bashika i Kadeshi.

Hanyuma barungikira intumwa umwami wa Edomu bamubwira bati: ‘Twemerere duce mu gihugu cawe.’ Ariko umwami wa Edomu ntiyatwemerera. Bongera barungika intumwa ku mwami wa Mowabu, na we nyene aranka. Abisirayeli baca baguma i Kadeshi.

Bavuye aho baciye baca mu bugaragwa, bazunguruka intara za Edomu na Mowabu, baca baja mu buseruko bw’igihugu ca Mowabu, bashinga amahema yabo i ruhande y’uruzi Arunoni. Ntibigeze binjira mu ntara ya Mowabu kuko Arunoni ni rwo rwari urubibe rwaho.
Nuko Abisirayeli barungika intumwa kuri Sihoni umwami w’Abamori yaba i Heshiboni, zimubwira ziti: ‘Twemerere duce mu guhugu cawe kugira ngo dushike mu gihugu cacu.’
Ariko Sihoni ntiyizera ivyo Abisirayeli bavuze, ababuza guca mu guhugu ciwe. Aca akoranya ingabo ziwe zose zija i Yahiza kugwanya Abisirayeli.
Maze Uhoraho Imana ya Isirayeli arekurira Sihoni n’ingabo ziwe mu maboko y’Abisirayeli, barabanesha. Abisirayeli baca bafata intara yose y’Abamori baba muri ico gihugu,
bagifata bahereye kuri Arunoni gushika kuri Yaboki, no kuva mu bugaragwa gushika kuri Yorodani.
Urabona rero ko ari Uhoraho Imana ya Isirayeli yafashe iyo ntara y’Abamori iyiha Isirayeli. None ni iki cotuma tuyibasubiza?
Mbega mweho ntimugumya ico Kemoshi imana yanyu yabahaye? Natwe ico Uhoraho Imana yacu yaduhaye cose turakigumya.
Mbega usumba Balaki mwene Zipori, umwami w’i Mowabu? Yarigeze atongana n’Abisirayeli canke ngo abagwanye?
Haheze imyaka amajana atatu Abisirayeli baba i Heshiboni, muri Aroweri no mu micungararo yaho, hamwe no mu bisagara biri ku nkengera ya Arunoni. None ubu ni ho uje kubibohoza?
Nta kibi nabakoreye, ariko ni wewe ugize nabi kuza kuntera. Uhoraho we mucamanza, abe ari we acira urubanza Abisirayeli n’Abamoni.”
Ariko umwami wa Amoni ntiyitaho ubwo butumwa Yefuta yamurungikiye.
Ico gihe Mpwemu w’ Uhoraho aza kuri Yefuta, ajabuka Gileyadi na Manase, aca i Misipehi h’i Gileyadi, avuye aho aca ayobora abasoda baja gutera Abamoni.
Yefuta asezeranira Uhoraho ati: “Niwampa intsinzi ku Bamoni,
ikija gusohoka kunsanganira ntahanye intsinzi ku Bamoni kizoba ari ic’ Uhoraho , nza kugishikana nk’ishikanwa rituriwe.”
Nuko Yefuta aja kugwanya Abamoni, Uhoraho amuha intsinzi kuri bo.
Asambura ibisagara mirongo ibiri kuva Aroweri gushika mu bisagara vya Miniti no muri Abeli-Keramimu. Maze Abisirayeli banesha Abamoni.

Yefuta agarutse i muhira i Misipa, ntihagira uwundi aza kumusanganira atari umukobwa wiwe, aza atambatamba ku gashako k’ingoma. Ni we mwana yari afise wenyene; nta wundi muhungu canke umukobwa yari afise.
Amubonye yitaburirako impuzu, asemerera ati: “Ewe mwana wanje urakankoreye! Urankwegeye amahano! Kuko nasezeraniye Uhoraho kandi sinisubirako.”
Na we amwishura ati: “Data, nimba hari ico wasezeraniye Uhoraho , ngira uko wasezeranye kuko Uhoraho aguhaye intsinzi nini ku bansi bawe, ari bo Bamoni.
Ariko unyemerere iki kimwe gusa: umpe amezi abiri, nduge mu mitumba nje kurirana n’abagenzi banje kuko nzopfa ntarongowe.”
Yefuta aramubwira ati: “Nugende.” Aramureka aragenda amarayo amezi abiri. We na bagenzi biwe baduga mu mitumba bararira kuko azopfa atarongowe.
Amezi abiri aheze, aca agaruka kwa se, na we amugira nk’uko yari yarasezeranye. Yapfuye ari inkumi. Vyahavuye biba umugenzo mu Bisirayeli
igihe cose uko umwaka utashe, inkumi z’Abisirayeli zarava mu gisagara zikamara imisi ine zibuka umukobwa wa Yefuta, Umunyagileyadi.

Abantu bo mu muryango wa Efurayimu bakoranya ingabo zabo, bajabuka Yorodani baja i Zafoni, babarira Yefuta bati: “Ni kubera iki wagiye kugwanya Abamoni utaduhamagaye ngo tujane? Tugira tuguturirane n’inzu yawe.”
Yefuta arishura ati: “Jewe n’abantu banje twari mu ngorane zikomeye n’Abamoni, kandi igihe nabahamagara, ntimwigeze muza kuntabara mu maboko yabo.
Mbonye mutaje kuntabara naciye nibako nja kubagwanya tutari kumwe, kandi Uhoraho yampaye intsinzi ku Bamoni. None ubu ni igiki gitumye muza kungwanya?”

Yefuta aca akoranya abantu b’i Gileyadi kugira ngo bagwanye aba Efurayimu. Abanyagileyadi barabatera, barabanesha, barabica kuko aba Efurayimu bari bavuze bati: “Mwebwe Abanyagileyadi muri abahunze bava mu turere twa Efurayimu na Manase.”

Abanyagileyadi bafata ivyambu vyo kuri Yorodani bija muri Efurayimu. Uwucitse kw’icumu mu bo kwa Efurayimu avuze ati: “Nimundeke ndengane,” Abanyagileyadi bakamubaza bati: “Uri uwo mu Befurayimu?” Akishura ati: “Oya,”

baca bamubwira bati: “Subiramwo uti ‘Shiboleti.’ ” Ari Umwefurayimu yaca avuga ati: “Siboleti,” kuko Abefurayimu batashobora kuvuga neza iryo jambo. Baca bamufata bakamwicira kw’ijabukiro rya Yorodani. Ico gihe hishwe abantu bangana n’ibihumbi mirongo ine na bibiri vy’Abefurayimu.
Yefuta aca amara imyaka itandatu arongora Abisirayeli. Maze Yefuta Umunyagileyadi apfuye, ahambwa mu gisagara ca Gileyadi.
Inyuma ya Yefuta haza Ibuzani w’i Betelehemu, arongora Abisirayeli.

Yari afise abahungu mirongo itatu n’abakobwa mirongo itatu nyene. Abakobwa biwe barongowe mu yindi miryango, maze na we azana abandi bakobwa mirongo itatu bavuye mu yindi miryango, barongorwa n’abahungu biwe. Ibuzani arongora Abisirayeli imyaka indwi.
Hanyuma arapfa, ahambwa i Betelehemu.
Inyuma yiwe haje Eloni yava mu muryango wa Zebuloni, arongora Abisirayeli imyaka icumi.
Hanyuma arapfa, ahambwa muri Ayijaloni mu ntara ya Zebuloni.
Eloni amaze gupfa, haje Abudoni mwene Hileli, yava i Piratoni, arongora Abisirayeli.
Yari afise abahungu mirongo ine, n’abuzukuru b’abahungu mirongo itatu, bari bafise indogoba mirongo indwi bagenderako. Yarongoye Abisirayeli imyaka umunani.
Apfuye, yahambwe i Piratoni mu ntara ya Efurayimu, mu misozi y’Abamaleki.
Abisirayeli basubira gukora ivyo Uhoraho abona ko ari bibi mu maso yiwe, maze Uhoraho abarekurira mu maboko y’Abafilisitiya, babacunaguza imyaka mirongo ine.
Hariho umugabo yaba i Zora yitwa Manowa, yava mu muryango wa Dani, yari afise umugore w’ingumba, babaho ata mwana bafise.
Umumarayika w’ Uhoraho abonekera uwo mugore, amubwira ati: “Naho uri ingumba ata mwana ufise, ugiye gusama inda, uvyare umwana w’umuhungu.
Nuko rero wirinde, ntihagire umuvinyu canke ikiboreza, canke ico kurya gihumanye kizokugera ku munwa.

Uzotwara inda uvyare umwana w’umuhungu. Ntihagire urwembe ruzomugera ku mutwe. Kuko uwo muhungu azokwegurirwa Imana nk’Umunaziri kuva akivuka. Ni we azotangura igikorwa co kurokora Abisirayeli mu minwe y’Abafilisitiya.”

Wa mugore aca arirukanga, abwira umugabo wiwe ati: “Hari umuntu w’Imana yaje aho ndi. Yasa n’umumarayika w’ Uhoraho , yari ateye ubwoba kuraba. Sinamubajije iyo aje ava, kandi ntiyambwiye izina ryiwe.

Ariko yambwiye ati: ‘Uzotwara inda, uvyare umwana w’umuhungu. Ntihazogire umuvinyu canke ikiboreza uzonywa, kandi ntihazogire ikintu gihumanye uzorya, kuko uwo muhungu azoba Umunaziri w’Imana kuva akivuka gushika apfe.’ ”
Maze Manowa aca asenga Uhoraho avuga ati: “Ndakwinginze Uhoraho, uturungikire uwo muntu w’Imana watumye, agaruke atwigishe ingene dukwiye kurera uwo mwana agiye kuvuka.”
Imana yumva isengesho rya Manowa, wa mumarayika w’ Uhoraho asubira kwiyereka wa mugore ari mu mirima, ariko Manowa umugabo wiwe ntibari kumwe.
Wa mugore aca arirukanga abwira umugabo wiwe ati: “Wa muntu yanyiyereka wa musi yagarutse!”
Manowa aca arahaguruka akurikira umugore wiwe. Bashikiriye wa muntu, Manowa aramubaza ati: “Ni wewe uvuganye n’umugore wanje?” Na we yishura ati: “Ni jewe nyene!”
Manowa aca amubaza ati: “Ivyo wavuze nivyashika, mbega amategeko azogenga uwo mwana ku bw’ubuzima bwiwe n’ivyo azokora azoba ameze gute?”
Wa mumarayika amwishura ati: “Umugore wawe aze akore ivyo namubwiye vyose.
Ntaze arye inzabibu, canke ngo anywe umuvinyu canke ikindi cose kiboreza, canke ngo arye ikintu na kimwe gihumanye. Hanyuma azokurikize ivyo namubariye vyose.”
Manowa aca abarira uwo mumarayika w’ Uhoraho ati: “Turakwinginze ugume ngaha tugutegurire ishashi y’impene ufungure.”

Wa mumarayika aramwishura ati: “Naho mwongumiza ngaha, sinobarira igifungurwa na kimwe. Ariko murashobora gutegura ikimazi co guturirwa, mukagihereza Uhoraho .” (Manowa ntiyari yamenye ko ari umumarayika w’ Uhoraho .)
Nuko Manowa abaza uwo mumarayika w’ Uhoraho ati: “Izina ryawe ni nde kugira ngo tuzokwibuke ivyo wavuze nivyashika?”
Na we arishura ati: “Ni kubera iki ugomba kumenya izina ryanje? Ni izina rirengeye ugutahura kwawe.”
Manowa aca afata umwagazi w’impene hamwe n’ishikanwa ry’ifu, abishikanira Uhoraho ku gitandara. Uhoraho aca akora igitangaza Manowa n’umugore wiwe babona:
Imbeya ziriko zirarabagirana ziduga mu kirere, wa mumarayika aca aduga muri izo mbeya. Manowa n’umugore wiwe babibonye, baca bakubita amavi hasi barunama.
Uwo mumarayika w’ Uhoraho ntiyabaye agisubira kwiyereka Manowa n’umugore wiwe, Manowa aca aratahura ko yari umumarayika w’ Uhoraho .
Aca abarira umugore wiwe ati: “Nta kabuza turapfuye, kuko twabonye Imana.”

Ariko umugore wiwe aramubwira ati: “Iyo Uhoraho agomba kutwica, ntiyari kutwakirira ikimazi gituriwe n’ishikanwa ry’ifu twamuhereje, canke ngo atwereke ivyo twabonye, ntiyari no kutubwira ivyo yatubwiye.”
Haheze igihe, uwo mugore avyara umwana w’umuhungu, amwita Samusoni. Arakura, kandi umuhezagiro w’ Uhoraho uba kuri we,
Mpwemu w’ Uhoraho atangura gukorera muri we ari i Mahane Dani, hagati y’ibisagara vya Zora na Eshitayoli.
Umusi umwe, Samusoni amanuka i Timuna, abona umwigeme w’Umufilisitiya, aramwipfuza.
Agarutse i muhira, abwira se na nyina ati: “Nashimye umukobwa w’Umufilisitiya i Timuna, muramunsabira, nipfuza ko twubakana ambere umugore.”

Se na nyina bamwishura bati: “Mbega nta mukobwa n’umwe wo mu miryango ya Isirayeli yoshobora kuba umugore wawe, aho urongora uwo mu ntakebwa z’Abafilisitiya?” Ariko Samusoni abarira se ati: “Genda umunsabire, kuko ni we numva nashimye.”
Se na nyina ntibari bazi ko ivyo vyari bivuye k’ Uhoraho kugira ngo haboneke akaryo ko kugwanya Abafilisitiya bari baganje Abisirayeli ico gihe.
Samusoni n’abavyeyi biwe bariko baramanuka bashika ku ruzabibu rw’i Timuna, intambwe itera Samusoni itontoma.
Ako kanya Mpwemu w’ Uhoraho amuzako n’ubushobozi bwinshi, aca ayitabaguza intoke nk’uko yotabagura umwagazi w’impene. Ariko ivyo ntiyigeze abibwira se na nyina.
Nuko Samusoni aramanuka i Timuna, avugana na wa mugore aca aramukunda cane.
Haheze igihe, ari mu nzira asubira i Timuna kugira ngo bagire ubugeni, akebereza gato hirya y’inzira kugira ngo arabe igikankara ca ya ntambwe, asanga cuzuyemwo inzuki nyinshi n’ubuki.
Aca abuhakuza amaboko agenda araburya. Ashikiriye abavyeyi biwe arabahako na bo bararya. Ariko ntiyigeze ababwira ko yabukuye mu magufa y’iyo ntambwe.
Mu gihe se wa Samusoni yari yagiye gutunganya ibisigaye ku bw’ubukwe, Samusoni yagize umusi mukuru i Timuna, nk’uko vyaba mu migenzo y’abasore.
Abavyeyi b’umugeni bamubonye, bamutoraniriza imisore mirongo itatu ngo ibe abagendanyi biwe.

Samusoni arababwira ati: “Reka ndabahe igisokozo. Nimwashobora kumpa inyishu mu misi indwi tuzomara turi mu misi mikuru, nzobaha imitamana mirongo itatu yera cane, hamwe n’imyambaro y’impuzu mirongo itatu.
Ariko namwe nimutagitora muzompa imitamana mirongo itatu yera cane, hamwe n’imyambaro y’impuzu mirongo itatu.” Na bo baramubwira bati: “Tubwire ico gisokozo.”
Arababwira ati: “Mu muryi havuyemwo ivyokurya, mu munyenkomezi havuyemwo ibisosa.” Inyuma y’imisi itatu ntibari bwaronke inyishu.

Ku musi ugira kane, babwira umugore wa Samusoni bati: “Hendahenda umugabo wawe agusigurire igisokozo yaduhaye, ahandi ho turaguturirana n’inzu ya so. Mwaduhamagariye ngaha kugira ngo mudusahure utwacu?”

Maze umugore wa Samusoni amugwako arira, avuga ati: “Urambesha ntunkunda, ahubwo uranyanka. Ni kubera iki ab’iwacu wabahaye igisokozo hanyuma ntiwambarira inyishu?” Na we aramwishura ati: “Na data na mama nta co nabasiguriye, wewe nari kukigusigurira kubera iki?”

Wa mugore aca yama arira igihe cose yaba ari kumwe na Samusoni muri iyo misi mikuru. Ariko ku musi ugira indwi, Samusoni abarira umugore wiwe inyishu, kuko yama ariko aramuririra i ruhande. Na we aca aja kubwira iyo nyishu ba basore.

Ku musi ugira indwi, imbere y’uko izuba rirenga, ba bantu baza aho Samusoni ari, bamubwira bati: “Mbega ni igiki gisosa gusumvya ubuki? Ni igiki gikomeye gusumvya intambwe?” Samusoni arababwira ati: “Iyo mutarimisha ishashi yanje ntimwari kumenya igisokozo canje.”

Maze Mpwemu w’ Uhoraho amuzako mu nkomezi nyinshi. Aca aja mu gisagara ca Ashikeloni, ahica abagabo mirongo itatu, abambura ivyabo, impuzu zabo aziha bamwe basigura ca gisokozo. Ariko Samusoni ababazwa cane n’ivyabaye, hanyuma asubira i muhira, abana na se na nyina.
Umugore wa Samusoni aca arongorwa n’umwe mu bagendaniye Samusoni mu misi mikuru yiwe.

Inyuma y’aho, hari mw’iyimbura ry’ingano, Samusoni afata umwagazi w’impene, awushira umugore wiwe nk’akaganuke. Avuga ati: “Ndagiye mu cumba c’umugore wanje turyamane.” Ariko se w’umukobwa aramwankira.
Amubwira ati: “Erega nagira ngo waramwanse. Ni co catumye ndamuha wa mugendanyi wawe wa mbere. Ariko ehe raba, murumunawe ni we mwiza kumurusha. Nabe ari we urongora.”
Samusoni ababwira ati: “Ubu rero ndaronse imvo yo gukorera Abafilisitiya ico nshaka. Nzobagirira nabi.”
Nuko aca arasohoka afata imbwebwe amajana atatu, azibohanya imirizo zibirizibiri, kuri iyo mirizo ibohanye akaja araboherako ibimuri.
Vya bimuri abidometse agaca azirungika mu mirima y’ingano y’Abafilisitiya. Aturira izo batekeye mu mikama hamwe n’izari zikiri mu mirima, aturira n’inzabibu hamwe n’imyelayo.

Abafilisitiya barabaza bati: “Ni nde yakoze ibi?” Bishura bati: “Ni Samusoni, umukwe w’umuntu w’i Timuna, kuko umugore wiwe yahawe umugendanyi wiwe.” Nuko Abafilisitiya baca baraduga bafata wa mugore bamuturirana na se.
Samusoni aca ababwira ati: “Ko mukoze ivyo, sinzogenda ntabihoye!”
Aca atera Abafilisitiya n’uburake bwinshi, yica benshi muri bo. Hanyuma aca amanuka mu bitandara vy’amabuye vy’i Etamu, abayo.
Abafilisitiya baca baraduga bashinga amahema yabo i Buyuda, amahema yabo yashika hafi y’igisagara ca Lehi.
Abantu b’i Buyuda barababaza bati: “Ni igiki gitumye muza kutugwanya?” Bishura bati: “Twaje gufata Samusoni tumugire imbohe, tumugirire nk’ivyo yatugiriye.”

Maze abantu ibihumbi bitatu bo mu Bayuda baca bamanuka kw’isenga ryo ku gitandara c’i Etamu, babwira Samusoni bati: “Mbega ntuzi ko Abafilisitiya ari bo batware bacu? Wabakoreye iki?” Abishura ati: “Nabakoreye ivyo na bo bankoreye.”
Na bo baramubwira bati: “Tuje kukuboha tugutange ku Bafilisitiya.” Samusoni arababwira ati: “Nimundahire ko mutanyica mwebwe nyene.”
Na bo bati: “Turakurahiye. Turakuboha gusa tugutange ku Bafilisitiya. Ntitukwica.” Baca bamubohesha ibiziriko bibiri bishasha, bamukura muri iryo senga.
Yegereye i Lehi, Abafilisitiya baca baza biha akamo k’intsinzi. Mpwemu w’ Uhoraho amuzako mu bushobozi bwinshi, acagagura vya biziriko nk’utunyuzi duhuye n’umuriro, birakoroka bimuva ku maboko.
Samusoni aravye ku ruhande abona igufa ry’umubangabanga w’indogoba, araritora, aryicisha Abafilisitiya igihumbi.
Samusoni aravuga ati: “Umubangabanga w’indogoba ndawurundishije ikirundo. Umubangabanga w’indogoba nawicishe abantu igihumbi.”
Ahejeje kuvuga ivyo aca ashibura wa mubangabanga, aho hantu haca hitwa Ramati-Lehi risigura ngo “agasozi k’umubangabanga”.
Kubera yari anyotewe cane, arasemerera asaba Uhoraho avuga ati: “Uhaye intsinzi ihambaye umusavyi wawe. None urandetse ngo nicwe n’inyota, ngwe mu maboko y’izi ntakebwa?”

Maze Imana isatura ahantu hari ikinogo i Lehi, ituma haza amazi, Samusoni aranywa, asubira kugira inkomezi. Iryo riba rica ryitwa Eni-Hakore, bisigura “Iriba ry’Uwasemereye” kandi riracariho i Lehi gushika n’ubu.
Samusoni yarongoye Abisirayeli imyaka mirongo ibiri igihe bari bagitwarwa n’Abafilisitiya.
Umusi umwe Samusoni aja i Gaza, ahura na maraya, aca aja kurarana na we.
Abantu b’i Gaza baramenya ko Samusoni ari ho ari, baca barakorana barara bamurindiririye ijoro ryose ku muryango w’igisagara bibwira bati: “Ejo nibwaca, tuzomwica.”

Ariko Samusoni wewe aryamayo gushika ijoro rigeze hagati gusa. Araheza aravyuka arandura umuryango w’ico gisagara, awurandurana n’ibihindizo hamwe n’ibizingiti vyawo. Avyiremeka ku rutugu, abidugana ku mutumba urabana na Heburoni.
Haheze imisi akunda umukobwa wo mu kiyaya ca Soreki, yitwa Delila.

Abatware b’Abafilisitiya baja kuraba Delila bamubwira bati: “Uzohendahende Samusoni akubwire aho akura inkomezi, akubwire n’ukuntu twomunesha kugira ngo tumubohe, tumumare amanyama. Umwe wese muri twebwe azoguha shekeli igihumbi n’ijana z’ifeza.”
Nuko Delila abaza Samusoni ati: “Ndakwinginze umbarire aho ukura izo nkomezi hamwe n’ukuntu umuntu yokuboha akakumara amanyama.”
Samusoni aramwishura ati: “Umuntu ambohesheje imigozi indwi ikiri mibisi, nca mba umunyantegenke nk’abandi bose.”
Nuko abatware b’Abafilisitiya bamuzanira imigozi indwi ikiri mibisi, arayimubohesha.

Yari yanyegeje abagabo mu cumba co haruguru c’iyo nzu, aca arasemerera ati: “Samusoni! Abafilisitiya baraje kugufata.” Samusoni aca avutagura ya migozi nk’uko inyuzi zicika zifashwe n’umuriro. Nuko inkomezi ziwe ntizamenyekana aho ziva.
Delila abwira Samusoni ati: “Ni kuki umpenda ukambwira ibinyoma? Mbwira neza rero ingene umuntu yokuboha akakugumya.”
Aramubwira ati: “Umuntu ambohesheje ibiziriko bishasha bitarakoreshwa, noca mba umunyantegenke nk’abandi bose.”

Nuko Delila aca afata ibiziriko bishasha arabimubohesha. Ba bantu bari binyegeje muri ca cumba nka kumwe kwa mbere. Delila aca arasemerera ati: “Samusoni! Ngaho Abafilisitiya baraje kugufata.” Samusoni acagagura vya biziriko nk’uwucagagura inyuzi.

Delila aca abwira Samusoni ati: “Wahereye kera umpenda. Mbwira rero ingene umuntu yokuboha.” Samusoni aramubwira ati: “Ibitsibo indwi vy’umushatsi wanje ubifatanije n’igitambara c’impuzu, hanyuma ukabibohera ku giti noca mba umunyantegenke nk’abandi bose.” Nuko Delila ahengera Samusoni asinziriye, afata vya bitsibo indwi vy’umushatsi wiwe abifatanisha igitambara c’impuzu.
Nuko arabijisha, abigumisha urumambo, aca asubira gusemerera ati: “Samusoni! Ngaho Abafilisitiya baraje kugufata!” Aca arazanzamuka ava mw’itiro, ashingura rwa rumambo hamwe n’ikijishirwako impuzu.
Delila aravuga ati: “Uvuga gute ngo urankunda, udashobora kumbwira amabanga yawe? Ubu bubaye ubwa gatatu umpenda, utambwira aho ukura inkomezi zawe.”
Maze akomeza kumuzigiriza uko bukeye uko bwije, gushika aho amubuza amahoro.

Ni ko kumubwira vyose ati: “Nta rwembe rurangera ku mutwe, kuko namye ndi Umunaziri w’Imana kuva nkivuka. Uwomwa uwu mushatsi, inkomezi zanje zose zoca zimvako, noca mba umunyantegenke nk’abandi bose.”

Delila abonye ko amubwiye vyose, aca atuma intumwa kuri ba batware b’Abafilisitiya, ababwira ati: “Nimusubire mugaruke, kuko ubu yambwiye vyose.” Ba batware baca baragaruka bazanye na za feza mu minwe.
Nuko Delila amusinziririza ku bibero vyiwe, aca ahamagara umuntu amumwa vya bitsibo indwi vy’umushatsi wiwe, gutyo aba amuhinduye umunyantegenke. Inkomezi zica ziramuvako.
Aca aramuhamagara ati: “Samusoni, ngaho Abafilisitiya baraje kugufata!” Aca arakanguka ava mw’itiro, yibwira ko abakira nk’ubwa mbere. Ariko ntiyari azi ko Uhoraho yamuretse.
Abafilisitiya baca baramufata, bamunogora amaso, bamumanukana i Gaza, bamubohesha umunyororo w’umwakaka, bamugira umusyi wo mw’ibohero.
Ariko umushatsi wiwe uca urasubira kumera inyuma yo kumumwa.

Umusi umwe abatware b’Abafilisitiya bakoranira hamwe ngo bashikanire ibimazi Dagoni imana yabo, bongere bagire umusi mukuru, kuko bagira bati: “Imana yacu yarekuriye Samusoni, umwansi wacu, mu maboko yacu.”
Abantu bose bamubonye bashima imana yabo bavuga bati: “Imana yacu ni yo yarekuriye umwansi wacu mu maboko yacu, uwatikije imirima yacu, akica benshi muri twebwe.”

Mu gihe abo bantu basa n’ababorewe, baca bavuga bati: “Nimukure Samusoni mw’ibohero abe aradutwenza.” Nuko bahamagara Samusoni ava mw’ibohero ngo abe arabatwenza. Nuko bamuhagarika hagati y’inkingi zibiri zari zifashe igisenge.
Samusoni abwira uwari amufashe ukuboko ati: “Nshira aho nshobora kwumva inkingi zibiri zifashe iyi ngoro, kugira ngo ndazegamire.”
Iyo nzu yari yuzuyemwo abagabo n’abagore, kandi n’abatware b’Abafilisitiya bose bari aho. Mu bibanza vyo hejuru hariyo abantu ibihumbi bitatu bariko bararaba ivyo Samusoni agira.
Maze Samusoni asenga Uhoraho avuga ati: “Ewe Uhoraho , Nyeninganji, ndakwinginze unyibuke. Mana, ndakwinginze umpe inkomezi iri rimwe gusa, kugira ngo nihore Abafilisitiya ku maso yanje abiri.”
Maze Samusoni aramvurira amaboko yiwe kuri za nkingi zibiri iyo nzu yari ihagazeko. Azisunikisha amaboko yose,

asenga ati: “Ndeka mpfane n’Abafilisitiya.” Asunika za nkingi n’inguvu nyinshi, iyo nzu isenyukira kuri ba batware n’abandi bose bari muri yo. Aho hantu yahiciye abantu baruta kure abo yishe mu yindi misi yose yabayeho.

Hanyuma abo bavukana hamwe n’umuryango wiwe wose baca baramanuka gutora ikiziga ciwe. Bamutahana iwabo, bamuhamba hagati y’i Zora n’i Eshitayoli, aho se wiwe Manowa yahambwe. Samusoni yatwaye Abisirayeli imyaka mirongo ibiri.
Hariho umugabo yitwa Mika yava mu karere k’imisozi ya Efurayimu.
Umusi umwe abarira nyina wiwe ati: “Narumvise uvuma uwakwivye shekeli igihumbi n’ijana z’ifeza. Ni jewe nazivye, ni jewe ndazifise.” Nyina amwishura ati: “ Uhoraho aguhezagire, mwana wanje.”

Amugarukaniye za shekeli igihumbi n’ijana z’ifeza, nyina aca avuga ati: “Izi feza ndazeguriye Uhoraho ku bw’umuhungu wanje kugira ngo zikorwemwo igishushanyo n’ikigirwamana cometseko ifeza. Nzoheza ndabiguhe bibe ivyawe.”
Mika aca asubiza ya mahera nyina wiwe, na we aca akuramwo shekeli amajana abiri aziha umucuzi, na we azicuramwo igishushanyo n’ikigirwamana, baca babishira mu nzu kwa Mika.
Mika yari afise akazu asengeramwo, aca akoresha efodi n’ibindi bishushanyo, agena n’umuhungu wiwe ngo abe umuherezi wiwe.
Muri ico gihe Abisirayeli nta mwami bari bafise, umuntu wese yakora ibintu uko avyumva.
Umusi umwe haza umusore w’Umulewi avuye i Betelehemu i Buyuda, yabaye mu muryango wa Yuda,
ava i Betelehemu arondera aho yoba. Ari ku rugendo ni ho yashika kwa Mika, mu ntara y’imitumba mu gihugu ca Efurayimu.
Mika aramubaza ati: “Uva he?” Aramwishura ati: “Ndi Umulewi w’i Betelehemu i Buyuda. Ndiko ndondera aho noba.”
Mika aramubwira ati: “Bana natwe, ube umuherezi wa data, nzoguhemba shekeli icumi ku mwaka, ndakwambike nongere ndakugaburire.”
Wa Mulewi aca aremera kubana na we, maze uwo musore aca aba nk’umwe mu bahungu biwe.
Mika agira uwo Mulewi umuherezi wiwe, aba mu nzu yiwe.
Mika aravuga ati: “Noneho menye ko Uhoraho azobana nanje, ko ndonse umuherezi w’Umulewi.”
Muri ico gihe Abisirayeli nta mwami bari bafise. Kandi muri ico gihe nyene, umuryango wa Dani wari ukiriko urironderera aho kuba, kuko batari bwaronke iragi ryabo mu miryango ya Isirayeli.

Nuko abo mu muryango wa Dani barungika abasoda batanu bava i Zora baja muri Eshitayoli gutata iyo ntara no kuyigenzura. Abo bantu baserukira umuryango wose wa Dani. Barababwira bati: “Genda mugenzure iyo ntara.” Ba bantu binjira mu karere k’imisozi ya Efurayimu, bashika ku nzu kwa Mika, bararaho.
Begereje inzu ya Mika, bumvise ijwi rya wa muhungu w’Umulewi baramumenya. Baca binjirayo baramubaza bati: “Ni nde yakuzanye ino? Ukora iki aha hantu? Ni kubera iki uri ngaha?”
Aca ababwira ivyo Mika yamukoreye ati: “Mika yampaye akazi ko kumubera umuherezi.”
Baca bamubwira bati: “Turakwinginze utubarize Imana ko urugendo rwacu ruzogenda neza.”
Wa muherezi arabishura ati: “Nimugende amahoro, Uhoraho azobana namwe mu rugendo rwanyu.”

Ba bantu baca baragenda bashika i Layishi, aho hantu basanga abantu baho bibereye mu mahoro nk’Abanyesidoni, ata co binona, batekaniwe. Kandi kubera ko intara yabo ata co yari ikenye, bari bateye imbere. Baba kure cane y’Abanyesidoni, kandi nta migenderanire bari bafitaniye n’abandi bantu na bamwe.
Basubiye i Zora n’i Eshitayoli, benewabo barababaza bati: “Mwasanze ibintu vyifashe gute?”
Bishura bati: “Nimuze tugende tubatere! Twabonye ko intara yabo ari nziza cane. Mbega murindiriye iki? Ntimwijijanye imitima, ingo tugende kuhafata.
Nitwashikayo, muzohasanga abantu ata co binona, hamwe n’intara nini cane Imana yarekuriye mu maboko yanyu, intara ata kintu na kimwe ikenye.”
Nuko abasoda amajana atandatu bo mu muryango wa Dani biteguriye intambara, bava i Zora n’i Eshitayoli.
Bari ku rugendo bashinga ikambi yabo ahitwa Kiriyati-Yeyarimu i Buyuda. Ni co gituma aho hantu hiswe Mahanehi Dani gushika n’ubu.
Bavuye aho baciye baja mu gihugu c’imitumba ca Efurayimu, bashika ku nzu kwa Mika.

Ba bantu batanu bari bagiye gutata iyo ntara ya Layishi babwira benewabo bati: “Mbe murazi ko muri izi nzu harimwo efodi, ibigirwamana vyo mu nzu, igishushanyo kibajwe hamwe n’ikindi c’igicurano? None tubigenze dute?”
Nuko baca barinjira mu nzu ya wa musore w’Umulewi kwa Mika, baramuramutsa.
Ba bantu amajana atandatu bari biteguriye urugamba basigara kw’irembo,

bamwe batanu bari bagiye gutata iyo ntara baba ari bo binjira, batwara ca gishushanyo c’ikibazano, efodi hamwe n’imana z’uwo muryango na ca gishushanyo c’igicurano, kandi wa muherezi na bamwe amajana atandatu bari bahagaze kw’irembo.
Wa muherezi abonye ba bantu binjiye mu kanyabugoro ka Mika bagatora ca gishushanyo, efodi, utugirwamana hamwe n’ikigirwamana gikozwe mu cuma, arababaza ati: “Ivyo mukora ni ibiki?”

Baramwishura bati: “Numa! Ntihagire ijambo na rimwe usubira kuvuga. Ingo ujane natwe utubere umuvyeyi n’umuherezi. Mbega si vyiza ko wobera umuherezi umuryango ukwiye wo mu Bisirayeli gusumba kumubera inzu y’umugabo umwe gusa?”
Wa muherezi aca aranezerwa, cane. Ahitana efodi n’ibindi bishushanyo vyo mu muryango na ca gishushanyo c’ikibazano, aca ajana n’abo bantu.
Ashira imbere abana batobato, ibitungwa hamwe n’ayandi matungo yabo, barahindukira bafata urugendo.
Bageze kure gatoya yo kwa Mika, ababanyi ba Mika na bo barahamagarana, bakurikira abo mu muryango wa Dani.
Bagenda barasemerera inyuma ya bene Dani, na bo barahindukira babwira Mika bati: “Ni ibiki? Ni kubera iki wahamagaye abo bantu ngo baze kutugwanya?”
Mika arabishura ati: “Mwatwaye imana nakoze, mutwarana n’umuherezi wanje. Hari na kimwe mwansigiye? Ni kubera iki mumbaza muti ‘Ni ibiki?’ ”
Bene Dani baramubwira bati: “Ntiwirirwe uraharira rero, ahandi ho abakaza ishavu bari ngaha boraka bakakurandurana n’umuryango wawe.”
Nuko bene Dani babandanya urugendo rwabo, Mika abonye ko bakomeye kumusumvya, aca arahindukira asubira i muhira.

Bene Dani baca bafata vya bigirwamana vya Mika hamwe n’umuherezi wiwe, barabandanya baja i Layishi, batera abantu bari bibereye mu mahoro ata co binona. Babaririkisha inkota, bongera baturira ico gisagara.

Nta muntu n’umwe bari bafise wo kubatabara kuko baba kure cane ya Sidoni kandi nta migenderanire bari bafitaniye n’abandi bantu na bamwe. Igisagara cari mu kiyaya hafi y’i Beti-Rehobu. Bene Dani baca basanura ico gisagara baciberamwo.
Baca bacita Dani, izina rya sekuruza wabo, yavutse kuri Isirayeli, ariko ico gisagara cari cahoze citwa Layishi.
Bene Dani baca bashinga vya bigirwamana, Yonatani mwene Gerishomu, Gerishomu mwene Mose, n’abahungu biwe, baba abaherezi b’umuryango wa Dani ibihe vyose gushika igihe batwarwa nk’inyagano.
Babaho bakoresha ivyo bigirwamana Mika yari yarikoreye mu gihe ihema ry’Imana ryari i Shilo.

Muri ico gihe, Abisirayeli nta mwami bari bafise. Hariho Umulewi yaba kure cane mu karere k’imisozi ya Efurayimu. Umusi umwe akura umugore i Betelehemu h’i Buyuda amuzana i muhira nk’umugore wa kabiri.
Ariko uwo mugore ntiyemera kugumana na we, asubira iwabo kwa se i Betelehemu.
Haciye amezi ane, umugabo wiwe afata ingingo yo kuja kumugarukana. Agenda ajanye umukozi wiwe n’indogoba zibiri. Wa mugore aramwakira, amushikana mu nzu kwa se. Se amubonye amwakirana urweze.
Sebukwe aramugobera aguma ngaho gato, na we ahamara imisi itatu, asangira na bo, aryama ngaho.
Ku musi ugira kane bazinduka kare, baritegura ngo bagende, ariko sebukwe aramubwira ati: “Banza ufungure hanyuma muheze mugende.”
Nuko bompi baricara, bararya, baranywa. Hanyuma se w’umukobwa amubwira ati: “Ndakwingize usubire urare, unezereze umutima wawe.”
Wa mugabo asubira kwizindura ngo agende, sebukwe yongera kumugobera, asubira kuharara irindi joro.
Mu gatondo k’umusi ugira gatanu, azindutse kugira ngo agende, sebukwe aramubwira ati: “Akira imfungurwa ufungure, uraba uragenda n’inyuma y’umutaga.” Nuko bamara uwundi musi.

Wa mugabo n’umugore wiwe hamwe n’umukozi wiwe bahagurutse ngo batahe, sebukwe aramubwira ati: “Ehe raba bugira bwire; umusi usa n’uwurangiye, rara iri joro unezereze umutima wawe, hanyuma ejo uzozinduke witahira.”
Ariko kuko uwo mugabo atashaka gusubira kuharara irindi joro, aca afata inzira ija i Yebusi ari ho i Yerusalemu, ari kumwe n’umugore wiwe na za ndogoba zibiri ziriko amatandiko yazo.
Begereje i Yebusi, bwari bumaze kwira cane, wa mukozi abwira shebuja ati: “Ingo tuje mu gisagara c’Abayebusi dusabeho indaro.”
Shebuja aramubwira ati: “Oya ntibishoboka. Ntitwinjira mu gisagara c’abanyamahanga, kitabamwo Abisirayeli. Turabandanya dushike i Gibeya.
Reka tubandanye turabe ko twoshika i Gibeya canke i Rama, turaza gusaba indaro muri ivyo bisagara.”
Nuko barabandanya, izuba rirenga begereje i Gibeya mu ntara ya Benyamini.
Bajayo kugira ngo baharare. Baragenda bahagarara ku mbuga y’igisagara ariko ntihagira n’umwe abakira ngo abahe indaro.
Kuri uwo mugoroba, haza umutama ava mu karere k’imisozi ya Efurayimu aba i Gibeya yari atashe avuye mu mirima. (Abantu baba ngaho bava mu umuryango wa Benyamini).
Abonye izo ngenzi ziri ku mbuga y’igisagara, abaza ati: “Muva he, mukaja he?”

Wa mugabo arishura ati: “Tuvuye i Betelehemu h’i Buyuda tuja kure cane mu karere k’imisozi ya Efurayimu, ni ho mba. Nahora i Betelehemu h’i Buyuda, ubu nkaba ndiko nsubira i muhira ariko habuze n’umwe yompa indaro y’iri joro.
Turifitiye ivyokurya bikwiye vy’indogoba zacu n’ivyacu twebwe abasavyi bawe, jewe, uwu musavyikazi, n’uwu musore turi kumwe. Nta na kimwe dukeneye.”
Wa mutama arababwira ati: “Nimushike muhira iwanje, ndabaha ivyo mukeneye vyose. Nawe nu ntimworara ku mbuga.”
Nuko arabashikana mu nzu, agaburira n’indogoba ziwe. Ahejeje kuboza ibirenge, baca barasangira ivyokurya.

Bakiriko baranezeranwa, abantu b’inkozi z’ibibi bo mu gisagara baraza bakikuza iyo nzu. Batangura guhondagura ku muryango bahamagara uwo mutama, bavuga bati: “Sohokana uwo mugabo aje kurara mu nzu yawe tumusambanye.”
Uwo mutama arasohoka ababwira ati: “Oya bagenzi banje, ndabinginze ntimukore ikibi kingana gityo. Uwu muntu ni umushitsi wanje, ntimukore igiterasoni nk’ico.
Ehe raba mfise umukobwa w’isugi, hari kandi n’umugore w’uwu mugabo. Reka ndababasohokanire mubakoze ico mushaka. Ariko uwo mugabo, ntimumukorere igiterasoni nk’ico.”
Ariko ba bantu ntibamwumviriza. Wa mugabo aca afata wa mugore wiwe amuterera hanze, bamukuranwako bamusambanya ijoro ryose, maze bugiye guca baramurekura.
Umutwenzi utamanzuye, wa mugore aca asubira ku nzu ya wa mutama, aho umugabo wiwe yari ari, ariko aca agwa imbere y’umuryango, agumaho gushika bukeye.
Mu gitondo, wa mugabo avyutse, yugurura umuryango, arasohoka ngo abandanye urugendo, asanga aho wa mugore yaguye imbere y’umuryango, afashe igishimaryango.
Aramubwira ati: “Haguruka tugende.” Ariko wa mugore ntiyamwishura. Wa mugabo aca amushira ku ndogoba, aramutahana.
Bashitse i muhira, wa mugabo aca afata imbugita, amucagaguramwo ibihimba icumi na bibiri, abirungika mu miryango icumi n’ibiri y’Abisirayeli.
Abantu bose babibonye baravuga bati: “Ububi nk’ubu ntibwari bwakaboneke kuva Abisirayeli bavuye muri Egiputa. Nimuvyiyumvireko, muheze mutubwire ico twokora.”
Abisirayeli bose uhereye i Dani ugashika i Berisheba no mu ntara ya Gileyadi baza bafise umutima umwe, bakoranira i Misipa imbere y’ Uhoraho .
Harimwo n’abarongozi b’imiryango ya Isirayeli. Abasoda bari ibihumbi amajana ane bitwaje inkota.
Abo mu muryango wa Benyamini baramenya ko Abisirayeli baduze i Misipa. Abisirayeli bavuga bati: “Tubwire ingene iryo bara ryaguye.”
Wa Mulewi, ari we mugabo wa wa mugore yishwe, aca ababwira ati: “Twe n’umugore wanje twashitse i Gibeya muri bene Benyamini ngo turareho.
Mw’ijoro haza abagabo b’i Gibeya bakikuza inzu twarimwo, bagomba kunyica. Ni ko gufata umugore wanje bakamusambanya gushika apfe.
Naciye mfata umugore wanje, ndamucamwo ibice icumi na bibiri, ndabirungika mu ntara zose zahawe Isirayeli, kuko aba bantu bakoze icaha c’agahomerabunwa.
None yemwe Bisirayeli, nimuvyiyumvire maze mugire ico mukoze.”
Bose bahagurukira rimwe bahuje umutima n’inama, bavuga bati: “Nta n’umwe muri twebwe asubira i muhira. Nta n’umwe!
Ahubwo Nguku uko tuja kugirira Gibeya: Reka tugire ubupfindo dutore abaja kuhatera.

Turatoranya ic’icumi c’abo mu miryango yose ya Isirayeli kugira ngo baje kuronderera ivyokurya ingabo. Abasoda bacu nibashika i Gibeya muri bene Benyamini, babakorere ibikwiranye n’ico caha giteye isoni bakoreye muri Isirayeli.”
Nuko Abisirayeli bose bahuriza umutima n’inama hamwe ko baja gutera ico gisagara.
Imiryango ya Isirayeli irungika intumwa muri bene Benyamini bati: “Vyangenze gute ngo ivyaha vy’agahomerabunwa nk’ivyo bikorerwe muri mwebwe?
Nimuduhe izo nkozi z’ibibi z’i Gibeya kugira ngo tuzice, dukure ikibi muri Isirayeli.” Ariko bene Benyamini ntibumvira benewabo b’Abisirayeli.
Ahubwo bava mu bisagara vyabo, bakoranira i Gibeya ngo bagwanye Abisirayeli.
