Bene Benyamini bakoranya abasoda ibihumbi mirongo ibiri na bitandatu bagwanisha inkota bavuye mu bisagara vyabo, biyongera ku bandi amajana indwi batoranijwe mu baba i Gibeya.
Muri abo harimwo abasoda amajana indwi bari abanyebamfu, bashobora guteza ibuye umugozi, bagatumbereza umushatsi ntibawuhushe.
Ingabo zo mu Bisirayeli bandi, havuyemwo bene Benyamini, bari bafise abasoda ibihumbi amajana ane bagwanisha n’inkota, bamenyereye intambara.
Abisirayeli baca baduga i Beteli, babaza Imana bati: “Ni nde muri twebwe akwiye gutera bene Benyamini ubwa mbere?” Uhoraho abishura ati: “Yuda nabe ari we agenda imbere.”
Bukeye Abisirayeli baravyuka bashinga amahema hafi y’i Gibeya.
Abasoda ba Isirayeli baja kugwanya bene Benyamini, bashinga ibirindiro hafi y’i Gibeya.
Abasoda bo muri bene Benyamini bavuye i Gibeya bica Abisirayeli ibihumbi mirongo ibiri na bibiri uwo musi.
Ariko Abisirayeli barongera baterana intege, basubira ku birindiro vyabo, aho baheruka kugwanira.
Kuko Abisirayeli bari baduze i Beteli kuririra Uhoraho kugeza izuba rirenze, basaba Imana bavuga bati: “Dusubire tuduge gutera bene Benyamini benewacu?” Uhorago abishura ati: “Nimugende mubatere.”
Abisirayeli barasubira begereza bene Benyamini umusi ugira kabiri.
Uwo musi na ho nyene bene Benyamini basohoka kubatangira, babicamwo abandi ibihumbi cumi n’umunani bazi kugwanisha inkota.
Maze Abisirayeli bose baca bongera kuduga i Beteli bicarayo, baririra imbere y’ Uhoraho umusi wose, barisonzesha gushika rirenze, bashikanira Uhoraho ibimazi bituriwe hamwe n’amashikanwa y’ishimwe.
Abisirayeli barondera mu nyonga z’ Uhoraho . Muri ico gihe Isandugu y’Isezerano y’Imana yari ikiri aho,

na Finehasi mwene Eliyazeri, Eliyazeri mwene Aroni yari umuherezi. Barabaza bati: “Dusubire tuduge kugwanya Ababenyamini benewacu? Canke tureke?” Uhoraho ababwira ati: “Nimugende kuko ejo nzobarekurira mu maboko yanyu.”
Maze Abisirayeli baragenda babunda inyuma y’i Gibeya bahakikuje.
Batera Ababenyamini umusi ugira gatatu, bagira ibirindiro nk’uko bari babigize ubwa mbere.
Ababenyamini barasohoka baza kubagwanya, barabirukana bava mu gisagara. Batangura kubica nk’ubwa mbere, Abisirayeli mirongo itatu bagwa mu gahinga no mu mabarabara aja i Beteli n’i Gibeya.
Ababenyamini bakiriko baravuga bati: “Turabanesheje nk’ubwa mbere,” Abisirayeli na bo bariko baravuga bati: “Reka tumere nk’abahunga dusubira inyuma tubakwege bave mu gisagara baje mu mabarabara.”
Abisirayeli bose baca bava aho bari bari bagira ibirindiro i Bayali-Tamari, abari babibundiye na bo baca baratera ku ruhande rwo hirya rwa Gibeya.
Abantu ibihumbi cumi bazi kugwana cane bavuye mu Bisirayeli bose baba ari bo baja imbere batera Gibeya. Urugamba rwari rukomeye cane, ariko Ababenyamini ntibari bwamenye amakuba abarindiriye.
Uhoraho aha Abisirayeli kunesha Ababenyamini, uwo musi Abisirayeli bica Ababenyamini ibihumbi mirongo ibiri na bitanu n’ijana bari bazi kugwanisha inkota.
Ababenyamini baca barabona ko baneshejwe. Abisirayeli bari bigize nk’abahunze imbere y’Ababenyamini kuko bari bizigiye ko bamwe binyegeje baca baronka ingene batera i Gibeya.
Maze abari binyegeje baca binjira ubwo nyene mu gisagara i Gibeya, baririkisha inkota ababayo bose.
Bari bumvikanye ko abo binyegeje bamaze kwinjira baca baturira ibintu vyinshi hakaduga umwotsi mwinshi mu kirere nk’ikimenyetso,
hanyuma Abisirayeli babonye uwo mwotsi, bagaca batera Ababenyamini. Ababenyamini bari bamaze kwica Abisirayeli mirongo itatu, baca bibwira bati: “Turiko turabanesha nk’ubwa mbere.”
Ariko wa mwotsi upfundutse uduga uva mu gisagara, Ababenyamini barahindukira babona umwotsi w’igisagara cose uduga kw’ijuru.
Abisirayeli baca barabahindukirira, Ababenyamini baca batekerwa n’ubwoba, kuko bari babonye ko uguhona kubashitseko.
Baca bahunga Abisirayeli baja mu bugaragwa, ariko ntivyakunda ko bahunga, kuko Abisirayeli bari mu gisagara baciye babatangira.
Nuko Abisirayeli bakikuza Ababenyamini, barabakurikira babafatira mu buseruko bwa Gibeya.
Abasoda ibihumbi cumi n’umunani bo muri bene Benyamini bamenyereye intambara bagwa muri iyo ntambara.
Bahindukiye ngo bahungire mu bugaragwa ku gitandara c’i Rimoni, Abisirayeli bicira ibihumbi bitanu mu nzira. Babandanya gusugereza bene Benyamini gushika i Gidomu, bica abandi ibihumbi bibiri.
Kuri uwo musi, abasoda ibihumbi mirongo ibiri na bitanu bo muri bene Benyamini bagwanisha inkota barishwe, kandi bose bari abahizi bakomeye.
Ariko amajana atandatu yo mu Babenyamini barashoboye guhungira mu bugaragwa ku gitandara c’i Rimoni, aho bamaze amezi ane.
Abisirayeli baca basubira mu bisagara vy’Ababenyamini baririkisha inkota ababibamwo bose, harimwo ibitungwa n’ikindi kintu cose bahasanze. Igisagara cabo cose bashikira baca bagiturira.
Igihe Abisirayeli bari bahuriye i Misipa bagira baje kugwanya Ababenyamini, bari barahiye bati: “Nta n’umwe wo muri twebwe azoshingira umukobwa wiwe Ababenyamini.”
Inyuma y’intambara n’Ababenyamini, abantu bose baca bahurira i Beteli, bicara imbere y’Imana gushika ku mugoroba, baborogana umubabaro mwinshi,
bavuga bati: “ Uhoraho , Mana ya Isirayeli, ni kubera iki ibi vyashikiye Isirayeli, bituma umuryango umwe uzimangana muri Isirayeli?”
Bukeye mu gatondo ka kare, abantu bubaka igicaniro bashikana ibimazi bituriwe hamwe n’ibimazi vy’ishimwe.

Abisirayeli baca barabaza bati: “Ni nde wo mu miryango ya Isirayeli atari kumwe natwe i Misipa aho twakoranira imbere y’ Uhoraho ?” Babajije gutyo kubera bari barahiriye imbere y’ Uhoraho ko uwutazokwifatanya na bo azokwicwa.
Maze Abisirayeli bagandarira benewabo ari bo Babenyamini, bavuga bati: “Uno musi umwe mu miryango ya Isirayeli wazimanganye.
None abacitse kw’icumu tuzobakwera abagore gute ko twarahiriye imbere y’ Uhoraho ko ata mukobwa wacu tuzobashingira?”
Barabaza bati: “Nta muryango wo mu Bisirayeli utakoraniye hamwe natwe imbere y’ Uhoraho i Misipa?” Basanga nta n’umwe w’i Yabeshi Gileyadi yaje muri iryo koraniro.
Kuko bamaze guharura abari bahari bose, basanze ata wo muri Yabeshi Gileyadi yari ngaho.
Ikoraniro rica rigena abasoda ibihumbi cumi na bibiri bamenyereye intambara, ngo baje i Yabeshi Gileyadi, bicishe inkota ababayo bose, harimwo abagore n’abana
Bababwira bati: “Uku abe ari ko muzobagenza: muzotikize abagabo n’abahungu bose, hamwe n’abagore bose batakiri inkumi.”
Baca basanga mu baba i Yabeshi Gileyadi harimwo inkumi amajana ane batararyamana n’abagabo, baca babatwara mw’ikambi i Shilo muri Kanani.
Ikoraniro ryose ry’Abisirayeli rica rirungika intumwa ku masigarira y’Ababenyamini bari ku gitandara c’i Rimoni kubabwira ko bashaka ko babana amahoro.
Nuko Ababenyamini basubira iwabo, bahabwa za nkumi z’i Yabeshi Gileyadi zari zazigurijwe. Ariko ntibabakwiye.
Abantu bose bagira umubabaro mwinshi ku bw’Ababenyamini kuko Uhoraho yari yaciye igihengeri mu miryango ya Isirayeli.
Abari barongoye ikoraniro baravuga bati: “Mbega abagabo basigaye bo muri bene Benyamini tuzobaha abagore dukuye he ko abagore bose bo mu muryango wa Benyamini bapfuye?”
Barongera bati: “Amasigarira yo mu muryango wa Benyamini ategerezwa kuronka abagore kugira ngo uwo muryango wa Isirayeli ntuzimangane ibihe vyose.
Ntidushobora kubaha abakobwa bacu kuko twarahiye tuti: ‘Azoba avumwe umuntu azoshingira umukobwa wiwe ku muntu wo mu muryango wa Benyamini.’
Baravugana bati: Ehe raba, hariho isabukuru y’ Uhoraho uko umwaka uheze ibera i Shilo, mu buraruko bwa Beteli no hakuno y’inzira iva i Beteli ija i Shekemu, hamwe no mu bumanuko bwa Lebona.”
Baca babwira abo mu muryango wa Benyamini bati: “Muzogende mwinyegeze mu mizabibu,
nimwabona abakobwa b’i Shilo bakoranye ngo batangure gutamba, muzoce muva mu mizabibu, umwe wese acakire umukobwa umwe amutware mu ntara ya Benyamini abe umugore wiwe.

Ba se babo canke basaza babo nibatwitwarako tuzobabwira tuti: ‘Nimutugirire ubuntu mubafashe, kuko tutashoboye kubaha abagore muri ya ntambara. Mwebwe nta co mwagirizwa kuko si mwebwe mwabashingiyeko abakobwa banyu.’ ”

Ababenyamini babikora uko babibwiwe. Mu gihe abakobwa bariko baratamba, umwe wese aca asumira umukobwa umwe aramutwara ngo abe umugore wiwe. Baca basubira mu ntara yabo, basubira kwubaka ibisagara, babibamwo.
Inyuma y’ivyo Abisirayeli baca basubira inyuma bamwebamwe bose mu miryango yabo, baja mu ntara zabo.
Muri ico gihe, Abisirayeli nta mwami bari bafise, umuntu wese yakora ibintu uko avyumva.
